自定义 destroy


D.2 关键记忆点
AOP 代理在步骤 12 创建：所以在 @PostConstruct（步骤 9）里调用被代理的方法不会走切面；
销毁回调对 prototype 无效：容器不管理 prototype Bean 的完整生命周期；
**@PostConstruct 在 Boot 3 来自 jakarta.annotation**。



全文因果链回顾：

IoC 基础：IoC 是控制反转，DI 是它的实现；容器管理 Bean 的创建、装配、生命周期
Bean 生命周期：11 个阶段，关键节点是实例化 → 属性填充 → 初始化 → AOP 代理 → 就绪
循环依赖：三级缓存（singletonObjects / earlySingletonObjects / singletonFactories），核心是延迟 AOP 代理决策；构造器注入、Prototype 无法解决
AOP：JDK 代理（有接口）/ CGLIB（无接口），代理时机在 postProcessAfterInitialization；失效场景：自调用、private/final、非容器 Bean
AOP 责任链：DefaultAdvisorChainFactory 组装 + ReflectiveMethodInvocation 递归放行，洋葱式嵌套
Spring MVC：九大组件 + DispatcherServlet.doDispatch() 三步走；参数解析靠 HandlerMethodArgumentResolver 链
Spring Boot：@SpringBootApplication = @SpringBootConfiguration + @EnableAutoConfiguration + @ComponentScan；自动配置靠 AutoConfigurationImportSelector 读取 .imports 文件
条件装配：@ConditionalOnMissingBean 是”用户可覆盖”的关键
事务：AOP + TransactionInterceptor，连接绑 ThreadLocal；传播行为、隔离级别、失效场景
缓存抽象：@Cacheable / @CachePut / @CacheEvict，缓存穿透/击穿/雪崩的解决方案
异步与调度：@Async + 自定义线程池 + AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler；@Scheduled + cron + 分布式锁
拦截机制：Filter（Servlet 层）/ Interceptor（MVC 层）/ AOP（方法层）
异常处理：@RestControllerAdvice + @ExceptionHandler + 错误码规范
Spring 6 / Boot 3 新特性：Jakarta EE 9+ 迁移、GraalVM Native Image、虚拟线程、HTTP Interface、函数式 Bean 注册

title: 限流算法详解
content:
一、为什么需要限流限流的本质，是在系统容量与请求流量之间划一条明确的边界。
1.1 不做限流的三种死法mindmap
  root((不做限流))
    被刷爆
      恶意爬虫
      刷单脚本
      正常用户被挤出
    被秒杀打崩
      流量是日常 1000 倍
      连接池耗尽
      系统雪崩
    被下游拖死
      下游只有 100 QPS
      上游重试风暴
      级联故障

1.2 限流 vs 其他稳定性手段flowchart LR
    A[请求到达] --> B{限流}
    B -- 通过 --> C[业务逻辑]
    B -- 拒绝 --> D[快速失败 429]
    C --> E{调用下游}
    E -- 成功 --> F[返回]
    E -- 失败率高 --> G[熔断]
    G --> H[降级兜底]
    H --> F




手段
触发时机
作用方向



限流
请求到达前
主动拒绝，保护系统


熔断
调用下游失败率高时
快速失败，保护调用方


降级
系统压力大 / 依赖不可用
关闭非核心，保核心


隔离
一直存在
资源不共享，限制爆炸半径



一句话：限流是”预先划定的容量”，降级是”故障时的保底”，熔断是”故障后的止损”，隔离是”故障前的预案”。


二、四种基础限流算法对比2.1 算法总览图flowchart TB
    subgraph FW[固定窗口]
        FW1[时间切成固定窗口] --> FW2[窗口内计数]
        FW2 --> FW3[超限拒绝]
    end
    subgraph SW[滑动窗口]
        SW1[记录时间戳/分桶] --> SW2[统计窗口内请求数]
        SW2 --> SW3[超限拒绝]
    end
    subgraph LB[漏桶]
        LB1[请求入桶] --> LB2[固定速率流出]
        LB2 --> LB3[桶满溢出拒绝]
    end
    subgraph TB[令牌桶]
        TB1[按速率生成令牌] --> TB2[请求取令牌]
        TB2 --> TB3[取到通过/取不到拒绝]
    end

2.2 对比表格


算法
原理
优点
缺点
适用场景



固定窗口
每秒计数，超限拒绝
实现简单，内存 O(1)
窗口边界突发（59s 和 01s 各 100 次可绕过）
粗略限流、日志采样


滑动窗口
记录请求时间戳，统计窗口内请求数
消除边界问题，精度高
内存开销随 QPS 增，需清理过期数据
网关、API 限流


漏桶
请求进桶，固定速率流出
流量绝对平滑
突发流量被削平，延迟增大
保护下游、流量整形


令牌桶
令牌按速率生成，请求取令牌
允许一定突发（桶容量）
桶容量需调参
秒杀、API 限流（允许突发）


2.3 四算法流量曲线对比xychart-beta
    title "四种算法对突发流量的处理曲线"
    x-axis ["0s", "0.2s", "0.4s", "0.6s", "0.8s", "1s", "1.2s", "1.4s"]
    y-axis "通过请求数" 0 --> 120
    line "原始流量" [100, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    line "固定窗口" [100, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    line "滑动窗口" [100, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    line "漏桶" [20, 20, 20, 20, 20, 20, 20, 20]
    line "令牌桶(容量100)" [100, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]

关键认知：

漏桶 vs 令牌桶：漏桶限制的是”流出速率”，令牌桶限制的是”平均速率 + 突发上限”。
固定窗口 vs 滑动窗口：前者是后者的粗糙近似，后者精度更高但内存开销大。


三、算法深度剖析3.1 固定窗口计数器原理图flowchart LR
    subgraph T["时间轴（阈值 100/秒）"]
        direction LR
        W1["0~1scounter=100"] --> W2["1~2scounter=100"] --> W3["2~3scounter=100"]
    end

伪代码class FixedWindowCounter {    private final int limit;    private final long windowMs;    private long windowStart = System.currentTimeMillis();    private int count = 0;    public synchronized boolean tryAcquire() {        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();        if (now - windowStart >= windowMs) {            windowStart = now;            count = 0;        }        if (count < limit) {            count++;            return true;        }        return false;    }}

致命缺陷：窗口边界问题sequenceDiagram
    participant U as 用户请求
    participant W1 as 窗口1 (0~1s)
    participant W2 as 窗口2 (1~2s)

    Note over W1: 阈值 100
    U->>W1: 0.9s 来了 100 个请求
    W1-->>U: 全部通过 ✅
    Note over W2: 阈值 100
    U->>W2: 1.1s 又来 100 个请求
    W2-->>U: 全部通过 ✅
    Note over U,W2: 结果：0.9~1.1s 这 200ms 内通过了 200 个请求瞬时 QPS 达 1000，限流形同虚设

改进方向：

把窗口切小（如 100ms），代价是精度提升有限
直接升级到滑动窗口


3.2 滑动窗口原理图flowchart LR
    subgraph SW["滑动窗口（动态右移）"]
        direction LR
        B1["桶1100ms"] --> B2["桶2100ms"] --> B3["桶3100ms"] --> B4["桶4100ms"] --> B5["桶N100ms"]
    end
    NOW(("当前时刻")) -.右边界.-> B5
    subgraph WIN["窗口内统计 = 所有桶 count 之和"]
    end

方式一：精确时间戳（内存高）class SlidingWindowLog {    private final int limit;    private final long windowMs;    private final Deque<Long> timestamps = new ArrayDeque<>();    public synchronized boolean tryAcquire() {        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();        // 移除窗口外的记录        while (!timestamps.isEmpty() && now - timestamps.peekFirst() >= windowMs) {            timestamps.pollFirst();        }        if (timestamps.size() < limit) {            timestamps.addLast(now);            return true;        }        return false;    }}

内存开销：每个请求一个 Long（8 字节）+ 队列开销。1000 QPS × 1 秒窗口 = 1000 个记录。如果窗口是 60 秒，QPS 是 1 万 → 60 万个记录 → 内存爆炸。
方式二：分桶统计（折中方案）把窗口切成 N 个小格子（如 10 个 100ms 的格子），每个格子一个计数器。窗口内请求数 = 所有桶的 count 之和。当时间前进时，新桶加入，旧桶淘汰（环形数组实现）。
flowchart TB
    subgraph Ring["环形数组（固定大小 N）"]
        direction LR
        R1["桶0"] --> R2["桶1"] --> R3["桶2"] --> R4["..."] --> R5["桶N-1"] --> R1
    end
    T["时间前进"] --> Advance["淘汰旧桶新桶清零"]
    Advance --> Ring
    Ring --> Sum["求和 → 判断是否超限"]

class SlidingWindowBucket {    private final int limit;    private final int bucketCount;    private final long bucketSizeMs;    private final int[] buckets;    private long lastBucketStart;    private int lastBucketIndex;    public synchronized boolean tryAcquire() {        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();        long curBucketStart = now - now % bucketSizeMs;        // 推进桶        while (lastBucketStart < curBucketStart) {            lastBucketIndex = (lastBucketIndex + 1) % bucketCount;            buckets[lastBucketIndex] = 0;            lastBucketStart += bucketSizeMs;        }        int total = 0;        for (int b : buckets) total += b;        if (total < limit) {            buckets[lastBucketIndex]++;            return true;        }        return false;    }}

精度 vs 内存的权衡：

桶越多，精度越高，内存越大
一般 10 个桶足够（误差 < 10%）

Sentinel 的实现：Sentinel 用的是 LeapArray + 滑动窗口，精度 1 秒分 2 个格子（500ms 一格），兼顾精度和性能。

3.3 漏桶原理图flowchart TB
    Req["请求↓↓↓"] --> Bucket
    subgraph Bucket["漏桶（容量 = 缓冲区大小）"]
        direction TB
        W["水位"]
        Hole["底部小孔"]
    end
    Bucket -- "固定速率流出" --> Down["下游服务"]
    Bucket -. "桶满则溢出（拒绝）" .-> Overflow["拒绝"]

核心特征流出速率恒定，无论进来多少，下游看到的永远是稳定速率。
伪代码class LeakyBucket {    private final int capacity;         // 桶容量    private final double leakRate;      // 每秒漏出速率    private double water = 0;           // 当前水量    private long lastLeak = System.currentTimeMillis();    public synchronized boolean tryAcquire() {        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();        // 按时间漏水        water = Math.max(0, water - (now - lastLeak) / 1000.0 * leakRate);        lastLeak = now;        if (water < capacity) {            water++;            return true;        }        return false;    }}

时序图sequenceDiagram
    participant U as 突发流量（100 个请求）
    participant B as 漏桶
    participant D as 下游（10 QPS）

    U->>B: T=0s 涌入 100 个
    B->>B: 水位上升到容量上限
    loop 每秒
        B->>D: 匀速漏出 10 个
    end
    Note over U,D: 通过曲线：恒定 10 QPS突发被强制平滑

适用场景
调用第三方 API（对方有严格速率限制）
保护数据库（不希望瞬间大批量写入）
流量整形（把突发流量整形为平滑流量）

缺点
突发流量会被”卡”在桶里，用户感知延迟增加
秒杀场景下，用户等了半天还是被拒绝 → 体验差


3.4 令牌桶原理图flowchart TB
    Gen["令牌生成器固定速率 r/s"] -- "放入令牌" --> Bucket
    subgraph Bucket["令牌桶（容量 C）"]
        T["🪙 🪙 🪙 🪙 🪙最多 C 个"]
    end
    Req["请求到达"] -- "取 1 个令牌" --> Bucket
    Bucket -- "取到" --> Pass["✅ 通过"]
    Bucket -- "取不到" --> Reject["❌ 拒绝"]

与漏桶的本质区别flowchart LR
    subgraph LB[漏桶]
        direction TB
        L1["进入"] --> L2["等待/排队"] --> L3["恒定速率流出"]
    end
    subgraph TB[令牌桶]
        direction TB
        T1["进入"] --> T2{"桶内有令牌?"}
        T2 -- 有 --> T3["立即通过（突发）"]
        T2 -- 无 --> T4["立即拒绝"]
    end




维度
漏桶
令牌桶



限制对象
流出速率
平均速率


突发支持
❌ 强制平滑
✅ 桶容量内允许突发


请求处理
入桶等待（或拒绝）
立即决策（取到/取不到）


用户体验
延迟增大
突发时响应快


伪代码public class TokenBucket {    private final int capacity;         // 桶容量：允许的瞬时突发    private final double rate;          // 令牌速率：每秒补充    private double tokens;    private long lastRefill = System.currentTimeMillis();    public TokenBucket(int capacity, double rate) {        this.capacity = capacity;        this.rate = rate;    }    public synchronized boolean tryAcquire() {        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();        // 按时间补充令牌（关键：惰性计算，不需要定时器）        tokens = Math.min(capacity, tokens + (now - lastRefill) / 1000.0 * rate);        lastRefill = now;        if (tokens >= 1) {            tokens -= 1;            return true;        }        return false;    }}

令牌补充过程（惰性补充）sequenceDiagram
    participant R as 请求
    participant TB as 令牌桶

    Note over TB: 初始 tokens=C
    R->>TB: T=0s 请求 1
    TB->>TB: 补令牌: min(C, C+0*rate) = C
    TB->>TB: tokens = C-1 → 通过

    R->>TB: T=0.1s 请求 2
    TB->>TB: 补令牌: min(C, (C-1)+0.1*rate)
    TB->>TB: tokens -= 1 → 通过

    Note over R,TB: 空闲一段时间

    R->>TB: T=10s 请求 N
    TB->>TB: 补令牌: min(C, 0+10*rate) = C
    Note over TB: 上限封顶，不会无限累积

关键设计点
惰性补充：不需要后台定时器，每次请求时按流逝时间计算应补充多少令牌。
上限封顶：Math.min(capacity, ...) 保证令牌不会无限累积。
**synchronized**：单机版保证线程安全；分布式场景必须用 Redis + Lua。

参数示例
容量 10，速率 5/s
瞬间来 20 个请求：前 10 个立即通过（消耗桶内令牌），之后按每秒 5 个放行
通过曲线：突发 10 + 匀速 5/s

xychart-beta
    title "令牌桶容量 10，速率 5/s 的通过曲线"
    x-axis "时间(s)" [0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4]
    y-axis "累计通过数" 0 --> 40
    line "实际通过" [10, 10, 15, 15, 20, 20, 25, 25, 30]
    line "匀速参考" [0, 2.5, 5, 7.5, 10, 12.5, 15, 17.5, 20]


四、为什么秒杀选令牌桶秒杀的特点是「开闸瞬间所有用户同时涌来」——流量曲线不是平滑的，而是脉冲式的。
4.1 各算法在秒杀场景的表现flowchart TB
    Sp["秒杀开场瞬间10 万请求"] --> FW
    Sp --> SW
    Sp --> LB
    Sp --> TB

    FW["固定窗口边界问题导致不公平"]
    SW["滑动窗口精度高但无突发能力"]
    LB["漏桶强制平滑，用户等待久"]
    TB["令牌桶✅ 允许桶内突发，快速放量"]

    style TB fill:#9f9,stroke:#333
    style FW fill:#f99,stroke:#333
    style SW fill:#fc9,stroke:#333
    style LB fill:#fc9,stroke:#333




算法
开场瞬间表现
问题



固定窗口
第 1 秒内只放 100 个，其余拒绝
边界问题导致不公平


滑动窗口
精度高，但依然严格限制
无突发能力，用户感知差


漏桶
强制平滑，大量请求排队
用户等半天还是失败，体验差


令牌桶
桶内令牌瞬间放量
需要预估桶容量


4.2 令牌桶的秒杀策略sequenceDiagram
    participant U as 10 万用户
    participant TB as 令牌桶(容量=1万,速率=5000/s)
    participant S as 库存系统

    U->>TB: T=0s 同时涌入 10 万
    TB-->>U: 前 1 万个（桶内令牌）立即通过
    TB-->>U: 其余 9 万个立即拒绝（快速失败）
    TB->>S: 平滑放量 5000/s

    Note over U,S: 设计哲学：1. 前 1 万快速通过，让"有能力的用户"进得来2. 后续平滑放量，保护下游库存3. 快速失败，不占连接

4.3 秒杀完整链路中的限流位置flowchart TB
    A["100 万请求"] --> B["CDN / 静态资源挡掉 90%"]
    B -- "~10 万" --> C["网关层（Nginx）令牌桶 10 万 QPS"]
    C -- "拒绝 90 万返回'排队失败'" --> X1["429"]
    C -- "~1 万" --> D["应用层Redis 分布式限流 5000 QPS"]
    D -- "拒绝超额返回'手慢了'" --> X2["429"]
    D -- "~5000" --> E["扣库存链路DB 乐观锁"]
    E --> F["下单成功"]

    style A fill:#fdd
    style B fill:#ddf
    style C fill:#dfd
    style D fill:#ffd
    style E fill:#9f9


五、分布式限流：单机限流 × N 实例 = 灾难5.1 问题本质单机限流（如 Guava RateLimiter、本地令牌桶）在分布式下各算各的。
flowchart TB
    LB["负载均衡"] --> A["实例A限流100收到300 → 拒200"]
    LB --> B["实例B限流100收到50 → 浪费50"]
    LB --> C["实例C限流100收到100 → 满载"]
    LB --> D["实例D限流100收到550 → 拒450"]

    Note["目标：全集群 1000 QPS实际：10 台 × 100 = 1000 QPS问题：流量不均 → 明明有余量却拒绝"]

    style A fill:#fdd
    style B fill:#dfd
    style D fill:#fdd

根本原因：单机限流是实例级的，不是服务级的。
5.2 分布式限流方案对比


方案
原理
优点
缺点



Redis + Lua
集中式计数/令牌桶
精确，易实现
Redis 是瓶颈，网络 RTT


Redis + 分段
每实例分配一段配额
减少 Redis 压力
流量不均时浪费


Nginx + Lua
网关层限流
挡在最前面
单点，需集群化


Sentinel 集群模式
Token Server 集中发令牌
成熟方案
需要额外部署


一致性哈希
按 key 路由到固定实例
无中心
扩缩容麻烦


5.3 Redis + Lua 的原子性sequenceDiagram
    participant C as 客户端
    participant R as Redis
    participant L as Lua 脚本

    Note over C,R: ❌ 错误：两条命令之间可能被其他请求插入
    C->>R: INCR key
    R-->>C: 1
    Note over C,R: ← 此处被其他请求插入！
    C->>R: EXPIRE key 1

    Note over C,R: ✅ 正确：Lua 脚本原子执行
    C->>R: EVALSHA script 1 key 100 1
    R->>L: 单线程执行 INCR + EXPIRE + 判断
    L-->>R: return 1
    R-->>C: 1

Lua 脚本（固定窗口版）：
-- KEYS[1]: 限流 key-- ARGV[1]: 最大请求数-- ARGV[2]: 窗口大小（秒）-- 返回：1 放行，0 限流local key    = KEYS[1]local max    = tonumber(ARGV[1])local window = tonumber(ARGV[2])local current = redis.call('INCR', key)if current == 1 then    redis.call('EXPIRE', key, window)endif current > max then    return 0endreturn 1

Lua 脚本的优势：

Redis 单线程执行 Lua，天然原子
一次网络往返，减少 RTT
脚本可缓存，后续调用只传 SHA1


六、网关层 + 应用层双层限流6.1 分层架构图flowchart TB
    subgraph L0["第 0 层：CDN / WAF"]
        CDN["静态资源CC 攻击防护"]
    end

    subgraph L1["第 1 层：网关（Nginx / SCG）"]
        GW["无状态内存令牌桶单机可扛百万连接挡掉 90% 流量"]
    end

    subgraph L2["第 2 层：应用"]
        APP["Redis 分布式限流（Lua 原子）按用户/接口细粒度与业务逻辑联动"]
    end

    subgraph L3["第 3 层：业务"]
        BIZ["DB / 缓存 / MQ"]
    end

    CDN --> GW --> APP --> BIZ

    style L0 fill:#eef
    style L1 fill:#efe
    style L2 fill:#ffe
    style L3 fill:#fee

6.2 为什么需要双层


层
优势
局限



网关层
无状态、性能高、挡在最前面
只能做粗粒度（IP、路径）


应用层
可访问业务上下文（用户ID、商品ID）
有状态、Redis 是瓶颈


核心原则：

能在网关挡住的，绝不放到应用层；能在应用层挡住的，绝不放到数据库。

6.3 网关层实现示例（Nginx）# 定义限流区：10MB 内存，按 IP 限流 100 QPSlimit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=api_limit:10m rate=100r/s;server {    location /api/seckill {        limit_req zone=api_limit burst=200 nodelay;        limit_req_status 429;        proxy_pass http://backend;    }}

参数含义：

rate=100r/s：漏桶速率（Nginx 用的是漏桶）
burst=200：允许的突发队列长度
nodelay：突发请求立即处理，不排队


七、动手实现7.1 手写令牌桶（单机版）/** * 单机令牌桶实现。 * <p> * 观察点：容量 10、速率 5 的桶——瞬间来 20 个请求， * 前 10 个通过，之后按每秒 5 个放行。 */public class TokenBucket {    private final int capacity;                    // 桶容量：允许的瞬时突发    private final double rate;                     // 令牌速率：每秒补充    private double tokens;    private long lastRefill = System.currentTimeMillis();    public TokenBucket(int capacity, double rate) {        this.capacity = capacity;        this.rate = rate;    }    public synchronized boolean tryAcquire() {        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();        tokens = Math.min(capacity, tokens + (now - lastRefill) / 1000.0 * rate);        lastRefill = now;        if (tokens >= 1) {            tokens -= 1;            return true;        }        return false;    }}

验证测试：
@Testvoid 令牌桶_突发10_之后匀速5每秒() throws InterruptedException {    TokenBucket bucket = new TokenBucket(10, 5);    // 瞬间 20 个请求    int pass1 = 0;    for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {        if (bucket.tryAcquire()) pass1++;    }    assertEquals(10, pass1); // 前 10 个通过（桶内令牌）    // 等 1 秒，应补充 5 个令牌    Thread.sleep(1000);    int pass2 = 0;    for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {        if (bucket.tryAcquire()) pass2++;    }    assertEquals(5, pass2);}

判定标准：跑出「突发 10 + 匀速 5/s」的通过曲线。
7.2 Redis + Lua 分布式令牌桶Lua 脚本：
-- KEYS[1]: 令牌桶 key-- ARGV[1]: 桶容量-- ARGV[2]: 令牌速率（每秒）-- ARGV[3]: 当前时间戳（毫秒）-- 返回：1 放行，0 限流local key      = KEYS[1]local capacity = tonumber(ARGV[1])local rate     = tonumber(ARGV[2])local now      = tonumber(ARGV[3])local bucket = redis.call('HMGET', key, 'tokens', 'lastRefill')local tokens = tonumber(bucket[1]) or capacitylocal lastRefill = tonumber(bucket[2]) or nowlocal delta = math.max(0, now - lastRefill)tokens = math.min(capacity, tokens + delta / 1000.0 * rate)local allowed = 0if tokens >= 1 then    tokens = tokens - 1    allowed = 1endredis.call('HMSET', key, 'tokens', tokens, 'lastRefill', now)redis.call('EXPIRE', key, math.ceil(capacity / rate) + 1)return allowed

Java 调用：
@Beanpublic DefaultRedisScript<Long> tokenBucketScript() {    DefaultRedisScript<Long> script = new DefaultRedisScript<>();    script.setScriptSource(new ResourceScriptSource(            new ClassPathResource("lua/token_bucket.lua")));    script.setResultType(Long.class);    return script;}public boolean tryAcquire(String key, int capacity, double rate) {    Long result = redis.execute(            tokenBucketScript,            Collections.singletonList(key),            String.valueOf(capacity),            String.valueOf(rate),            String.valueOf(System.currentTimeMillis())    );    return result != null && result == 1L;}

7.3 Spring 拦截器落地7.3.1 注解定义@Target({ElementType.METHOD, ElementType.TYPE})@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)public @interface RateLimit {    String key() default "";              // 限流维度    int max() default 100;                // 最大请求数    int window() default 1;               // 窗口秒数    String message() default "请求过于频繁，请稍后再试";}

7.3.2 拦截器@Slf4j@Component@RequiredArgsConstructorpublic class RateLimitInterceptor implements HandlerInterceptor {    private final StringRedisTemplate redis;    private static final DefaultRedisScript<Long> RATE_LIMIT_SCRIPT =            new DefaultRedisScript<>(                """                local current = redis.call('INCR', KEYS[1])                if current == 1 then redis.call('EXPIRE', KEYS[1], ARGV[2]) end                if current > tonumber(ARGV[1]) then return 0 end                return 1                """,                Long.class            );    private static final ThreadLocal<Long> START_TS = new ThreadLocal<>();    @Override    public boolean preHandle(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse resp, Object handler) {        if (!(handler instanceof HandlerMethod hm)) return true;        RateLimit rl = hm.getMethodAnnotation(RateLimit.class);        if (rl == null) rl = hm.getBeanType().getAnnotation(RateLimit.class);        if (rl == null) return true;        START_TS.set(System.currentTimeMillis());        Long userId = UserContext.currentUserId();        String caller = userId == null ? req.getRemoteAddr() : String.valueOf(userId);        String key = "zeus:doc:rl:" + rl.key() + ":" + hm.getMethod().getName() + ":" + caller;        Long allowed = redis.execute(                RATE_LIMIT_SCRIPT,                Collections.singletonList(key),                String.valueOf(rl.max()),                String.valueOf(rl.window())        );        if (allowed != null && allowed == 0L) {            log.warn("[RateLimit] 限流触发 key={}, max={}/{}, user={}",                    key, rl.max(), rl.window(), caller);            write429(resp, rl.message());            return false;        }        return true;    }    @Override    public void postHandle(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse resp,                           Object handler, ModelAndView mav) {        Long start = START_TS.get();        if (start != null && handler instanceof HandlerMethod hm) {            long cost = System.currentTimeMillis() - start;            if (cost > 500) {                log.warn("[RT] 慢接口 {} cost={}ms", hm.getMethod().getName(), cost);            }        }    }    @Override    public void afterCompletion(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse resp,                                Object handler, Exception ex) {        START_TS.remove(); // 必须 remove，防止线程池线程复用导致内存泄漏    }    private void write429(HttpServletResponse resp, String msg) {        try {            resp.setStatus(429);            resp.setContentType("application/json;charset=UTF-8");            resp.getWriter().write("{\"code\":429,\"msg\":\"" + msg + "\"}");        } catch (Exception e) {            log.error("[RateLimit] 写 429 响应失败", e);        }    }}

7.3.3 请求处理时序图sequenceDiagram
    participant C as 客户端
    participant I as RateLimitInterceptor
    participant R as Redis
    participant B as 业务方法

    C->>I: 请求 /api/seckill
    I->>I: 解析注解 RateLimit
    I->>I: START_TS.set(now)
    I->>R: EVAL script (INCR + EXPIRE)
    R-->>I: 1（放行）/ 0（限流）
    alt 放行
        I->>B: 执行 preHandle → true
        B-->>I: 业务返回
        I->>I: postHandle 计算耗时
    else 限流
        I-->>C: 429 + JSON
    end
    I->>I: afterCompletion: START_TS.remove()

注册拦截器：
@Configurationpublic class WebMvcConfig implements WebMvcConfigurer {    @Override    public void addInterceptors(InterceptorRegistry registry) {        registry.addInterceptor(rateLimitInterceptor)                .addPathPatterns("/api/**")                .excludePathPatterns("/api/health", "/api/login");    }}

使用：
@RestControllerpublic class SeckillController {    @RateLimit(key = "seckill", max = 5, window = 1, message = "手慢了，请稍后再试")    @PostMapping("/api/seckill/{skuId}")    public R<Void> seckill(@PathVariable Long skuId) {        return R.ok();    }}


八、限流与降级的联动8.1 核心理念
限流是「预先划定的容量」，降级是「故障时的保底」——两者必须联动。

当限流指标（拒绝率）超过阈值，说明系统真被打到了，触发降级——关闭非核心功能（购物车、推荐位、评论），把资源全部让给下单链路。
8.2 因果链流程图flowchart TB
    A["秒杀开场"] --> B["流量洪峰"]
    B --> C["限流触发，拒绝率飙升"]
    C --> D{"拒绝率 > 30%?"}
    D -- 是 --> E["触发降级开关"]
    D -- 否 --> F["保持正常"]
    E --> G["关闭非核心功能"]
    G --> G1["商品详情推荐位 → 返回缓存"]
    G --> G2["用户评论 → 静态兜底"]
    G --> G3["购物车 → 只读"]
    G1 --> H["核心链路独占资源"]
    G2 --> H
    G3 --> H
    H --> I["下单 / 扣库存"]

    style E fill:#f99
    style H fill:#9f9
    style I fill:#9f9

8.3 实现思路@Componentpublic class DegradeSwitch {    private final AtomicBoolean seckillMode = new AtomicBoolean(false);    /** 限流拒绝率超过 30% 时，进入秒杀降级模式 */    public void onRateLimitRejected(double rejectRate) {        if (rejectRate > 0.3 && seckillMode.compareAndSet(false, true)) {            log.warn("[Degrade] 拒绝率 {}，进入秒杀降级模式", rejectRate);        }    }    /** 非核心功能入口判断 */    public boolean isNonCoreEnabled() {        return !seckillMode.get();    }}

业务代码里的降级：
@GetMapping("/api/product/{id}")public R<ProductVO> detail(@PathVariable Long id) {    ProductVO vo = productService.getById(id);    // 非核心功能：推荐位    if (degradeSwitch.isNonCoreEnabled()) {        vo.setRecommendations(recommendService.getRelated(id));    } else {        vo.setRecommendations(Collections.emptyList()); // 降级    }    return R.ok(vo);}

8.4 关键原则
秒杀开场瞬间，任何非核心请求都是对核心链路的伤害。
降级是「主动选择服务哪些流量」——不是被动故障处理，而是主动的容量管理。


九、生产实践 Checklist9.1 限流维度设计

9.2 参数调优


参数
建议
说明



桶容量
平均 QPS × 2~5 秒
允许 2~5 秒的突发


令牌速率

再小精度收益低

9.3 常见坑


坑
现象
解决

内存爆炸

一个用户拖垮全站

9.4 监控指标flowchart LR

    Prom --> Graf["Grafana 大盘"]
    Graf --> Alert["告警规则"]
    Alert --> WX["企业微信 / 钉钉"]

    style Alert fill:#f99

9.5 降级预案


场景
降级动作



Redis 不可用
切本地限流（Guava）+ 告警

放行（fail-open），记录日志


拒绝率 > 30%
触发降级，关闭非核心


拒绝率 > 50%
启动排队机制，返回”预计等待时间”



十、常见面试问题Q1：固定窗口的边界问题怎么解决？答：升级到滑动窗口。滑动窗口有两种实现：

精确时间戳（内存高，O(QPS × 窗口)）
分桶统计（内存低，精度略低，Sentinel 用这种）

固定窗口切小粒度只能缓解，无法根治。

Q2：漏桶和令牌桶的本质区别？答：

漏桶限制流出速率，请求必须排队等待，强制平滑，不允许突发。
令牌桶限制平均速率，桶容量内的突发可以立即通过，允许突发。

一句话：漏桶是”你按我的节奏走”，令牌桶是”你可以在额度内自由发挥”。
flowchart LR
    subgraph LB[漏桶]
        L1["请求"] --> L2["排队"] --> L3["匀速流出"]
    end
    subgraph TB[令牌桶]
        T1["请求"] --> T2["查令牌"] --> T3{"有?"} --> |有| T4["立即通过"]
        T3 --> |无| T5["立即拒绝"]
    end


Q3：分布式限流怎么保证总量？答：核心是集中式计数器。方案：

Redis + Lua（推荐）：原子性强，一次 RTT。
分段配额：每实例预分配一段，减少 Redis 压力，但流量不均时浪费。
Sentinel 集群模式：Token Server 集中发令牌。

面试重点：单机限流 × N 实例 ≠ 总量限流。

Q4：令牌桶的令牌为什么要惰性补充？答：如果每 100ms 定时补一次令牌，需要后台定时器，N 个限流 key 就需要 N 个定时任务，资源浪费。惰性补充是每次请求时按流逝时间计算应补多少，把 O(N) 的定时成本变成 O(1) 的请求成本。

Q5：限流和熔断的区别？答：



维度
限流
熔断



触发时机
请求到达前
调用下游失败率高时


保护对象
自己
调用方


状态
无状态/简单状态
三态（关闭/半开/打开）


恢复方式
自动（时间窗口）
需探测（半开状态试调用）


stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Closed: 初始
    Closed --> Open: 失败率超阈值
    Open --> HalfOpen: 等待时间到
    HalfOpen --> Closed: 探测成功
    HalfOpen --> Open: 探测失败


Q6：限流阈值怎么定？答：三步法：

压测确定单机容量：P99 RT < 200ms 时的最大 QPS。
留 20% buffer：阈值 = 压测值 × 0.8。
动态调整：通过 Nacos 配置，大促前手动调整。

不要拍脑袋：max=1000 这种数字必须有压测数据支撑。

Q7：限流拦截器为什么用 ThreadLocal 记录开始时间？答：preHandle 和 postHandle / afterCompletion 是同一个线程执行的（同步请求），用 ThreadLocal 传递状态最简单。**必须 remove()**，因为 Tomcat 线程池会复用线程，不 remove 会导致内存泄漏 + 脏数据。
注意：异步请求（Callable、DeferredResult）会切换线程，ThreadLocal 会失效，需要改用 RequestContextHolder 或 AsyncListener。

Q8：为什么 429 响应要带 Retry-After？答：HTTP 标准里，429 表示 “Too Many Requests”，配合 Retry-After 头告诉客户端多久后重试：
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many RequestsRetry-After: 1Content-Type: application/json{"code": 429, "msg": "请求过于频繁，请 1 秒后重试"}

好处：

规范客户端行为，避免盲目重试
配合指数退避，保护服务端

title: 5年后端进阶方向
content:
工作 5 年左右的后端，最危险的状態是：什么都会一点，但什么都不精；能写业务，但扛不住事；能完成需求，但做不了技术决策。
这个阶段的核心不是“学更多”，而是从“实现者”变成“负责人”。如果只能选三个重点，我的排序是：

系统设计 > 问题定位 > 性能调优 > 工程能力 > 源码 > 项目实践

项目实践不是单独的能力，而是训练以上能力的载体。没有项目实践，其他都是纸上谈兵；但只有项目实践，没有刻意训练，就是重复劳动。

一、先看清 5 年经验的分水岭


阶段
核心能力
评价标准



1-3 年
实现能力
能把需求变成代码，能改 Bug


3-5 年
负责能力
能独立负责一个模块/系统，能定位线上问题，能做小范围设计


5-8 年
决策能力
能做技术选型、架构设计、带小团队、对稳定性负责


8 年以上
业务/战略
技术驱动业务，定方向，控成本


5 年经验如果还在拼“谁写的代码多”，方向就偏了。你应该拼的是：谁能让系统更稳、更快、更省、更好维护。

二、各项能力优先级与训练方法🥇 第一优先级：系统设计（决定天花板）这是 5 年经验最该补的课。不是画几张架构图，而是在约束下做权衡。
要训练的具体能力：

能独立设计一个中型系统：电商订单、支付、IM、Feed 流、权限系统等。
能画清楚：部署拓扑、调用链路、数据流向、存储选型。
能做容量估算：QPS、存储、带宽、机器数。
能权衡：CAP、一致性、可用性、成本、开发效率。
能设计高可用：限流、熔断、降级、隔离、重试、幂等。
能设计数据层：分库分表、缓存策略、读写分离、冷热分离。
能设计消息链路：顺序、幂等、堆积、死信、最终一致性。

训练方法：

复盘现有系统：画出你当前负责系统的架构图，标出单点、瓶颈、故障域。
做重构方案：假设流量涨 10 倍，哪里会挂？怎么改？写一份方案。
读经典：《数据密集型应用系统设计》《凤凰架构》《高性能 MySQL》。
用 C4 模型：Context、Container、Component、Code，逼自己分层表达。
参与设计评审：主动旁听或主导，学习别人怎么权衡。

自测标准： 给你一个模糊需求，你能在 1 小时内给出可落地的架构草案，并说清取舍。

🥈 第二优先级：问题定位与线上排障（决定信任度）5 年经验，如果线上出问题你还只会重启，那很难让人放心。能快速定位问题，是资深工程师的入场券。
要训练的具体能力：

CPU 飙高：top → jstack → 定位线程 → 代码行。
内存泄漏/OOM：jmap dump → MAT 分析 → 大对象/GC Roots。
死锁/线程阻塞：jstack 看 BLOCKED/WAITING。
慢 SQL：explain → 索引 → 锁 → 执行计划。
GC 问题：看懂 GC 日志，判断 YoungGC/FGC 频率与耗时。
网络问题：tcpdump、netstat、连接池、TIME_WAIT。
中间件问题：Redis 热 key、大 key；MQ 堆积；ES 慢查询。
全链路追踪：TraceId 串起日志，定位跨服务延迟。

工具必须熟练：

Arthas：watch、trace、jad、tt。
jstack、jmap、jstat、jcmd。
MAT、VisualVM、Async Profiler。
explain、show processlist、慢查询日志。
tcpdump、wireshark、iftop。

训练方法：

主动参与线上值班，不要怕出事。
建故障演练：模拟 CPU 100%、内存泄漏、慢 SQL。
写故障报告：现象 → 影响 → 排查 → 根因 → 修复 → 防复发。
复盘历史故障：把公司过往事故拿出来，自己推演一遍。

自测标准： 线上 CPU 100%，你能在 10 分钟内定位到具体代码行。

🥉 第三优先级：性能调优（决定系统上限）调优不是背参数，而是一套方法论：监控 → 瓶颈 → 假设 → 验证 → 固化。
要训练的具体能力：

JVM 调优：堆大小、GC 选择、GC 参数、内存布局。
MySQL 调优：索引优化、执行计划、锁、事务隔离、分库分表。
Redis 调优：大 key、热 key、持久化、集群、缓存策略。
MQ 调优：批量、压缩、分区、消费并行度、堆积处理。
线程池调优：核心/最大/队列/拒绝策略，隔离不同业务。
全链路压测：JMeter、wrk、 Gatling，找 TP99 瓶颈。
操作系统调优：文件句柄、TCP 参数、内存交换。

训练方法：

本地造数据：50 万行 MySQL，压测不同索引。
线上灰度：小流量验证调优效果。
读源码：线程池、HashMap、ConcurrentHashMap、Netty。
看监控：Prometheus + Grafana，建立性能基线。

自测标准： 接口 TP99 从 500ms 降到 100ms，你能说清每一步做了什么、为什么。

🏗️ 第四优先级：工程能力（决定协作效率）5 年经验不能只对自己负责，还要对交付质量、团队效率负责。
要训练的具体能力：

CI/CD：GitLab CI、Jenkins、Docker、K8s 基本编排。
可观测性：日志规范、Metrics、Tracing、告警。
测试策略：单元测试、集成测试、契约测试、混沌工程。
代码质量：CheckStyle、SonarQube、Code Review 规范。
发布策略：蓝绿、灰度、金丝雀、回滚。
文档能力：设计文档、接口文档、故障报告、复盘。
协作推动：跨团队沟通、需求评审、技术方案宣讲。

训练方法：

主导一次小项目：从需求到上线，完整走一遍。
写一份技术方案：让不懂的人也能看懂。
推动一个改进：比如引入 SonarQube、优化发布流程。

自测标准： 你能带 2-3 个人完成一个中等项目，并保证按时高质量交付。

📖 第五优先级：源码（按需，不要为了读而读）源码是解决问题的手段，不是目的。5 年经验应该有选择地深入。
重点源码：

JDK：HashMap、ConcurrentHashMap、AQS、线程池、ArrayList。
Spring：Bean 生命周期、循环依赖、AOP、事务。
MyBatis：Mapper 代理、SQL 解析、缓存。
Netty：Reactor 线程模型、ByteBuf、粘包拆包。
中间件：RocketMQ/Kafka、Redis、Elasticsearch 核心机制。

训练方法：

带着问题读：线上遇到循环依赖，再去看三级缓存。
画流程图：把核心流程画出来，比读十遍强。
写 Demo：手写一个简化版线程池、IOC 容器。

自测标准： 能说清 Spring 循环依赖为什么需要三级缓存，而不是两级。

🚀 项目实践：不是能力，是训练场项目实践本身不构成能力，刻意练习才构成能力。
正确姿势：

不要只做 CRUD，主动认领有挑战的模块。
不要只完成需求，主动思考为什么这么做、有没有更好的方案。
不要只写代码，主动参与设计、评审、排障、调优、复盘。
不要只做新功能，主动做重构、稳定性、性能优化。

自测标准： 你能否说出过去一年，你负责的系统在稳定性、性能、可维护性上具体提升了多少？

三、时间分配建议（每周 10 小时学习）


方向
时间
具体动作



系统设计
3h
读 1 篇经典 + 画 1 张架构图 + 写 1 份方案


问题定位/调优
3h
本地模拟故障 + 分析 GC/慢 SQL + 写复盘


源码
2h
带着问题读 1 个核心流程 + 画图


工程/软技能
2h
写文档、推动改进、参与评审


项目实践贯穿始终：把学习内容直接应用到当前项目，哪怕只是优化一个接口、加一个监控。

四、常见误区
❌ 只刷题：算法是敲门砖，5 年经验更看系统设计和稳定性。
❌ 只读源码：读了一堆，线上问题还是不会定位。
❌ 追新框架：学不完，底层原理和设计思想才是根本。
❌ 忽视业务：不懂业务，设计就是空中楼阁。
❌ 只做不说：不会写方案、不会汇报，影响力上不去。
❌ 重复劳动：三年经验用五年，而不是五年经验。


五、一句话总结5 年经验的后端，重点训练三件事：能设计（系统设计）、能兜底（问题定位）、能优化（性能调优）。工程能力是放大器，源码是工具箱，项目实践是训练场。
如果只能选一个立刻开始的动作：画出你当前负责系统的架构图，标出三个最可能挂的点，并写出改进方案。 这一步做完，你就已经进入资深工程师的思考模式了。

title: Changed
content:
The CAP theorem asserts that any net­worked shared-data system can have only two of three desirable properties. How­ever, by explicitly handling partitions, designers can optimize consistency and availability, thereby achieving some trade-off of all three.
In the decade since its introduction, designers and researchers have used (and sometimes abused) the CAP theorem as a reason to explore a wide variety of novel distributed systems. The NoSQL movement also has applied it as an argument against traditional databases.
The CAP theorem states that any networked shared-data system can have at most two of three desirable properties:

consistency (C) equivalent to having a single up-to-date copy of the data;
high availability (A) of that data (for updates); and
tolerance to network partitions (P).

This expression of CAP served its purpose, which was to open the minds of designers to a wider range of systems and tradeoffs; indeed, in the past decade, a vast range of new systems has emerged, as well as much debate on the relative merits of consistency and availability. The “2 of 3” formulation was always misleading because it tended to oversimplify the tensions among properties. Now such nuances matter. CAP prohibits only a tiny part of the design space: perfect availability and consistency in the presence of partitions, which are rare.
Although designers still need to choose between consistency and availability when partitions are present, there is an incredible range of flexibility for handling partitions and recovering from them. The modern CAP goal should be to maximize combinations of consistency and availability that make sense for the specific application. Such an approach incorporates plans for operation during a partition and for recovery afterward, thus helping designers think about CAP beyond its historically perceived limitations.
Why “2 of 3” is missleadingThe easiest way to understand CAP is to think of two nodes on opposite sides of a partition. Allowing at least one node to update state will cause the nodes to become inconsistent, thus forfeiting C. Likewise, if the choice is to preserve consistency, one side of the partition must act as if it is unavailable, thus forfeiting A. Only when nodes communicate is it possible to preserve both consistency and availability, thereby forfeiting P. The general belief is that for wide-area systems, designers cannot forfeit P and therefore have a difficult choice between C and A. In some sense, the NoSQL movement is about creating choices that focus on availability first and consistency second; databases that adhere to ACID properties (atomicity, consistency, isolation, and durability) do the opposite. The “ACID, BASE, and CAP” sidebar explains this difference in more detail.
In fact, this exact discussion led to the CAP theorem. In the mid-1990s, my colleagues and I were building a variety of cluster-based wide-area systems (essentially early cloud computing), including search engines, proxy caches, and content distribution systems.1 Because of both revenue goals and contract specifications, system availability was at a premium, so we found ourselves regularly choosing to optimize availability through strategies such as employing caches or logging updates for later reconciliation. Although these strategies did increase availability, the gain came at the cost of decreased consistency.
The first version of this consistency-versus-availability argument appeared as ACID versus BASE,2 which was not well received at the time, primarily because people love the ACID properties and are hesitant to give them up. The CAP theorem’s aim was to justify the need to explore a wider design space-hence the “2 of 3” formulation. The theorem first appeared in fall 1998. It was published in 19993 and in the keynote address at the 2000 Symposium on Principles of Distributed Computing,4 which led to its proof.
As the “CAP Confusion” sidebar explains, the “2 of 3” view is misleading on several fronts. First, because partitions are rare, there is little reason to forfeit C or A when the system is not partitioned. Second, the choice between C and A can occur many times within the same system at very fine granularity; not only can subsystems make different choices, but the choice can change according to the operation or even the specific data or user involved. Finally, all three properties are more continuous than binary. Availability is obviously continuous from 0 to 100 percent, but there are also many levels of consistency, and even partitions have nuances, including disagreement within the system about whether a partition exists.
Exploring these nuances requires pushing the traditional way of dealing with partitions, which is the fundamental challenge. Because partitions are rare, CAP should allow perfect C and A most of the time, but when partitions are present or perceived, a strategy that detects partitions and explicitly accounts for them is in order. This strategy should have three steps: detect partitions, enter an explicit partition mode that can limit some operations, and initiate a recovery process to restore consistency and compensate for mistakes made during a partition.
Acid, base, and capACID and BASE represent two design philosophies at opposite ends of the consistency-availability spectrum. The ACID properties focus on consistency and are the traditional approach of databases. My colleagues and I created BASE in the late 1990s to capture the emerging design approaches for high availability and to make explicit both the choice and the spectrum. Modern large-scale wide-area systems, including the cloud, use a mix of both approaches.
Although both terms are more mnemonic than precise, the BASE acronym (being second) is a bit more awkward: Basically Available, Soft state, Eventually consistent. Soft state and eventual consistency are techniques that work well in the presence of partitions and thus promote availability.
The relationship between CAP and ACID is more complex and often misunderstood, in part because the C and A in ACID represent different concepts than the same letters in CAP and in part because choosing availability affects only some of the ACID guarantees. The four ACID properties are:
Atomicity (A). All systems benefit from atomic operations. When the focus is availability, both sides of a partition should still use atomic operations. Moreover, higher-level atomic operations (the kind that ACID implies) actually simplify recovery.
Consistency (C). In ACID, the C means that a transaction pre-serves all the database rules, such as unique keys. In contrast, the C in CAP refers only to single]copy consistency, a strict subset of ACID consistency. ACID consistency also cannot be maintained across partitions.partition recovery will need to restore ACID consistency. More generally, maintaining invariants during partitions might be impossible, thus the need for careful thought about which operations to disallow and how to restore invariants during recovery.
Isolation (I). Isolation is at the core of the CAP theorem: if the system requires ACID isolation, it can operate on at most one side during a partition. Serializability requires communication in general and thus fails across partitions. Weaker definitions of correctness are viable across partitions via compensation during partition recovery.
Durability (D). As with atomicity, there is no reason to forfeit durability, although the developer might choose to avoid needing it via soft state (in the style of BASE) due to its expense. A subtle point is that, during partition recovery, it is possible to reverse durable operations that unknowingly violated an invariant during the operation. However, at the time of recovery, given a durable history from both sides, such operations can be detected and corrected. In general, running ACID transactions on each side of a partition makes recovery easier and enables a framework for compensating transactions that can be used for recovery from a partition.
Cap-latency connectionIn its classic interpretation, the CAP theorem ignores latency, although in practice, latency and partitions are deeply related. Operationally, the essence of CAP takes place during a timeout, a period when the program must make a fundamental decision-the partition decision:

cancel the operation and thus decrease availability, or

proceed with the operation and thus risk inconsistency.


Retrying communication to achieve consistency, for example, via Paxos or a two-phase commit, just delays the decision. At some point the program must make the decision; retrying communication indefinitely is in essence choosing C over A.
Thus, pragmatically, a partition is a time bound on communication. Failing to achieve consistency within the time bound implies a partition and thus a choice between C and A for this operation. These concepts capture the core design issue with regard to latency: are two sides moving forward without communication?
This pragmatic view gives rise to several important consequences. The first is that there is no global notion of a partition, since some nodes might detect a partition, and others might not. The second consequence is that nodes can detect a partition and enter a partition mode-a central part of optimizing C and A.
Finally, this view means that designers can set time bounds intentionally according to target response times; systems with tighter bounds will likely enter partition mode more often and at times when the network is merely slow and not actually partitioned.
Sometimes it makes sense to forfeit strong C to avoid the high latency of maintaining consistency over a wide area. Yahoo’s PNUTS system incurs inconsistency by maintaining remote copies asynchronously.5 However, it makes the master copy local, which decreases latency. This strategy works well in practice because single user data is naturally partitioned according to the user’s (normal) location. Ideally, each user’s data master is nearby.
Facebook uses the opposite strategy:6 the master copy is always in one location, so a remote user typically has a closer but potentially stale copy. However, when users update their pages, the update goes to the master copy directly as do all the user’s reads for a short time, despite higher latency. After 20 seconds, the user’s traffic reverts to the closer copy, which by that time should reflect the update.
Cap confusionAspects of the CAP theorem are often misunderstood, particularly the scope of availability and consistency, which can lead to undesirable results. If users cannot reach the service at all, there is no choice between C and A except when part of the service runs on the client. This exception, commonly known as disconnected operation or offline mode,7 is becoming increasingly important. Some HTML5 features-in particular, on-client persistent storage-make disconnected operation easier going forward. These systems normally choose A over C and thus must recover from long partitions.
Scope of consistency reflects the idea that, within some boundary, state is consistent, but outside that boundary all bets are off. For example, within a primary partition, it is possible to ensure complete consistency and availability, while outside the partition, service is not available. Paxos and atomic multicast systems typically match this scenario.8 In Google, the primary partition usually resides within one datacenter; however, Paxos is used on the wide area to ensure global consensus, as in Chubby,9 and highly available durable storage, as in Megastore.10
Independent, self-consistent subsets can make forward progress while partitioned, although it is not possible to ensure global invariants. For example, with sharding, in which designers prepartition data across nodes, it is highly likely that each shard can make some progress during a partition. Conversely, if the relevant state is split across a partition or global invariants are necessary, then at best only one side can make progress and at worst no progress is possible.
Does choosing consistency and availability (CA) as the “2 of 3” make sense? As some researchers correctly point out, exactly what it means to forfeit P is unclear.11,12 Can a designer choose not to have partitions? If the choice is CA, and then there is a partition, the choice must revert to C or A. It is best to think about this probabilistically: choosing CA should mean that the probability of a partition is far less than that of other systemic failures, such as disasters or multiple simultaneous faults.
Such a view makes sense because real systems lose both C and A under some sets of faults, so all three properties are a matter of degree. In practice, most groups assume that a datacenter (single site) has no partitions within, and thus design for CA within a single site; such designs, including traditional databases, are the pre-CAP default. However, although partitions are less likely within a datacenter, they are indeed possible, which makes a CA goal problematic. Finally, given the high latency across the wide area, it is relatively common to forfeit perfect consistency across the wide area for better performance.
Another aspect of CAP confusion is the hidden cost of forfeiting consistency, which is the need to know the system’s invariants. The subtle beauty of a consistent system is that the invariants tend to hold even when the designer does not know what they are. Consequently, a wide range of reasonable invariants will work just fine. Conversely, when designers choose A, which requires restoring invariants after a partition, they must be explicit about all the invariants, which is both challenging and prone to error. At the core, this is the same concurrent updates problem that makes multithreading harder than sequential programming.
Managing partitionsThe challenging case for designers is to mitigate a par­tition’s effects on consistency and availability. The key idea is to manage partitions very explicitly, including not only detection, but also a specific recovery process and a plan for all of the invariants that might be violated during a partition. This management approach has three steps:


detect the start of a partition,
enter an explicit partition mode that may limit some operations, and
initiate partition recovery when communication is restored.

The last step aims to restore consistency and compensate for mistakes the program made while the system was partitioned.
Figure 1 shows a partition’s evolution. Normal operation is a sequence of atomic operations, and thus partitions always start between operations. Once the system times out, it detects a partition, and the detecting side enters partition mode. If a partition does indeed exist, both sides enter this mode, but one-sided partitions are possible. In such cases, the other side communicates as needed and either this side responds correctly or no communication was required; either way, operations remain consistent. However, because the detecting side could have inconsistent operations, it must enter partition mode. Systems that use a quorum are an example of this one-sided partitioning. One side will have a quorum and can proceed, but the other cannot. Systems that support disconnected operation clearly have a notion of partition mode, as do some atomic multicast systems, such as Java’s JGroups.
Once the system enters partition mode, two strategies are possible. The first is to limit some operations, thereby reducing availability. The second is to record extra information about the operations that will be helpful during partition recovery. Continuing to attempt communication will enable the system to discern when the partition ends.
Which operations should proceed?Deciding which operations to limit depends primarily on the invariants that the system must maintain. Given a set of invariants, the designer must decide whether or not to maintain a particular invariant during partition mode or risk violating it with the intent of restoring it during recovery. For example, for the invariant that keys in a table are unique, designers typically decide to risk that invariant and allow duplicate keys during a partition. Duplicate keys are easy to detect during recovery, and, assuming that they can be merged, the designer can easily restore the invariant.
For an invariant that must be maintained during a partition, however, the designer must prohibit or modify operations that might violate it. (In general, there is no way to tell if the operation will actually violate the invariant, since the state of the other side is not knowable.) Externalized events, such as charging a credit card, often work this way. In this case, the strategy is to record the intent and execute it after the recovery. Such transactions are typically part of a larger workflow that has an explicit order-processing state, and there is little downside to delaying the operation until the partition ends. The designer forfeits A in a way that users do not see. The users know only that they placed an order and that the system will execute it later.
More generally, partition mode gives rise to a fundamental user-interface challenge, which is to communicate that tasks are in progress but not complete. Researchers have explored this problem in some detail for disconnected operation, which is just a long partition. Bayou’s calendar application, for example, shows potentially inconsistent (tentative) entries in a different color.13 Such notifications are regularly visible both in workflow applications, such as commerce with e-mail notifications, and in cloud services with an offline mode, such as Google Docs.
One reason to focus on explicit atomic operations, rather than just reads and writes, is that it is vastly easier to analyze the impact of higher-level operations on invariants. Essentially, the designer must build a table that looks at the cross product of all operations and all invariants and decide for each entry if that operation could violate the invariant. If so, the designer must decide whether to prohibit, delay, or modify the operation. In practice, these decisions can also depend on the known state, on the arguments, or on both. For example, in systems with a home node for certain data, 5 operations can typically proceed on the home node but not on other nodes.
The best way to track the history of operations on both sides is to use version vectors, which capture the causal dependencies among operations. The vector’s elements are a pair (node, logical time), with one entry for every node that has updated the object and the time of its last update. Given two versions of an object, A and B, A is newer than B if, for every node in common in their vectors, A’s times are greater than or equal to B’s and at least one of A’s times is greater.
If it is impossible to order the vectors, then the updates were concurrent and possibly inconsistent. Thus, given the version vector history of both sides, the system can easily tell which operations are already in a known order and which executed concurrently. Recent work14 proved that this kind of causal consistency is the best possible outcome in general if the designer chooses to focus on availability.
Partition recoveryAt some point, communication resumes and the partition ends. During the partition, each side was available and thus making forward progress, but partitioning has delayed some operations and violated some invariants. At this point, the system knows the state and history of both sides because it kept a careful log during partition mode. The state is less useful than the history, from which the system can deduce which operations actually violated invariants and what results were externalized, including the responses sent to the user. The designer must solve two hard problems during recovery:

the state on both sides must become consistent, and
there must be compensation for the mistakes made during partition mode.

It is generally easier to fix the current state by starting from the state at the time of the partition and rolling forward both sets of operations in some manner, maintaining consistent state along the way. Bayou did this explicitly by rolling back the database to a correct time and replaying the full set of operations in a well-defined, deterministic order so that all nodes reached the same state.15 Similarly, source-code control systems such as the Concurrent Versioning System (CVS) start from a shared consistent point and roll forward updates to merge branches.
Most systems cannot always merge conflicts. For example, CVS occasionally has conflicts that the user must resolve manually, and wiki systems with offline mode typically leave conflicts in the resulting document that require manual editing.16
Conversely, some systems can always merge conflicts by choosing certain operations. A case in point is text editing in Google Docs,17 which limits operations to applying a style and adding or deleting text. Thus, although the general problem of conflict resolution is not solvable, in practice, designers can choose to constrain the use of certain operations during partitioning so that the system can automatically merge state during recovery. Delaying risky operations is one relatively easy implementation of this strategy.
Using commutative operations is the closest approach to a general framework for automatic state convergence. The system concatenates logs, sorts them into some order, and then executes them. Commutativity implies the ability to rearrange operations into a preferred consistent global order. Unfortunately, using only commutative operations is harder than it appears; for example, addition is commutative, but addition with a bounds check is not (a zero balance, for example).
Recent work by Marc Shapiro and colleagues at INRIA18,19 has greatly improved the use of commutative operations for state convergence. The team has developed commutative replicated data types (CRDTs), a class of data structures that provably converge after a partition, and describe how to use these structures to

ensure that all operations during a partition are commutative, or
represent values on a lattice and ensure that all operations during a partition are monotonically increasing with respect to that lattice.

The latter approach converges state by moving to the maximum of each side’s values. It is a formalization and improvement of what Amazon does with its shopping cart:20 after a partition, the converged value is the union of the two carts, with union being a monotonic set operation. The consequence of this choice is that deleted items may reappear.
However, CRDTs can also implement partition-tolerant sets that both add and delete items. The essence of this approach is to maintain two sets: one each for the added and deleted items, with the difference being the set’s membership. Each simplified set converges, and thus so does the difference. At some point, the system can clean things up simply by removing the deleted items from both sets. However, such cleanup generally is possible only while the system is not partitioned. In other words, the designer must prohibit or postpone some operations during a partition, but these are cleanup operations that do not limit perceived availability. Thus, by implementing state through CRDTs, a designer can choose A and still ensure that state converges automatically after a partition.
Compensating for mistakesIn addition to computing the postpartition state, there is the somewhat harder problem of fixing mistakes made during partitioning. The tracking and limitation of partition-mode operations ensures the knowledge of which invariants could have been violated, which in turn enables the designer to create a restoration strategy for each such invariant. Typically, the system discovers the violation during recovery and must implement any fix at that time.
There are various ways to fix the invariants, including trivial ways such as “last writer wins” (which ignores some updates), smarter approaches that merge operations, and human escalation. An example of the latter is airplane overbooking: boarding the plane is in some sense partition recovery with the invariant that there must be at least as many seats as passengers. If there are too many passengers, some will lose their seats, and ideally customer service will compensate those passengers in some way.
The airplane example also exhibits an externalized mistake: if the airline had not said that the passenger had a seat, fixing the problem would be much easier. This is another reason to delay risky operations: at the time of recovery, the truth is known. The idea of compensation is really at the core of fixing such mistakes; designers must create compensating operations that both restore an invariant and more broadly correct an externalized mistake.
Technically, CRDTs allow only locally verifiable invariants-a limitation that makes compensation unnecessary but that somewhat decreases the approach’s power. However, a solution that uses CRDTs for state convergence could allow the temporary violation of a global invariant, converge the state after the partition, and then execute any needed compensations.
Recovering from externalized mistakes typically requires some history about externalized outputs. Consider the drunk “dialing” scenario, in which a person does not remember making various telephone calls while intoxicated the previous night. That person’s state in the light of day might be sound, but the log still shows a list of calls, some of which might have been mistakes. The calls are the external effects of the person’s state (intoxication). Because the person failed to remember the calls, it could be hard to compensate for any trouble they have caused.
In a machine context, a computer could execute orders twice during a partition. If the system can distinguish two intentional orders from two duplicate orders, it can cancel one of the duplicates. If externalized, one compensation strategy would be to autogenerate an e-mail to the customer explaining that the system accidentally executed the order twice but that the mistake has been fixed and to attach a coupon for a discount on the next order. With-out the proper history, however, the burden of catching the mistake is on the customer.
Some researchers have formally explored compensating transactions as a way to deal with long-lived transactions.21,22 Long-running transactions face a variation of the partition decision: is it better to hold locks for a long time to ensure consistency, or release them early and expose uncommitted data to other transactions but allow higher concurrency? A typical example is trying to update all employee records as a single transaction. Serializing this transaction in the normal way locks all records and prevents concurrency. Compensating transactions take a different approach by breaking the large transaction into a saga, which consists of multiple subtransactions, each of which commits along the way. Thus, to abort the larger transaction, the system must undo each already committed subtransaction by issuing a new transaction that corrects for its effects-the compensating transaction.
In general, the goal is to avoid aborting other transactions that used the incorrectly committed data (no cascading aborts). The correctness of this approach depends not on serializability or isolation, but rather on the net effect of the transaction sequence on state and outputs. That is, after compensations, does the database essentially end up in a place equivalent to where it would have been had the subtransactions never executed? The equivalence must include externalized actions; for example, refunding a duplicate purchase is hardly the same as not charging that customer in the first place, but it is arguably equivalent. The same idea holds in partition recovery. A service or product provider cannot always undo mistakes directly, but it aims to admit them and take new, compensating actions. How best to apply these ideas to partition recovery is an open problem. The “Compensation Issues in an Automated Teller Machine” sidebar describes some of the concerns in just one application area.
System designers should not blindly sacrifice consistency or availability when partitions exist. Using the proposed approach, they can optimize both properties through careful management of invariants during partitions. As newer techniques, such as version vectors and CRDTs, move into frameworks that simplify their use, this kind of optimization should become more wide-spread. However, unlike ACID transactions, this approach requires more thoughtful deployment relative to past strategies, and the best solutions will depend heavily on details about the service’s invariants and operations.
Compensation issues in an automated teller machineIn the design of an automated teller machine (ATM), strong consistency would appear to be the logical choice, but in practice, A trumps C. The reason is straightforward enough: higher availability means higher revenue. Regardless, ATM design serves as a good context for reviewing some of the challenges involved in compensating for invariant violations during a partition.
The essential ATM operations are deposit, withdraw, and check balance. The key invariant is that the balance should be zero or higher. Because only withdraw can violate the invariant, it will need special treatment, but the other two operations can always execute.
The ATM system designer could choose to prohibit withdrawals during a partition, since it is impossible to know the true balance at that time, but that would compromise availability. Instead, using stand-in mode (partition mode), modern ATMs limit the net withdrawal to at most k, where k might be $200. Below this limit, withdrawals work completely; when the balance reaches the limit, the system denies withdrawals. Thus, the ATM chooses a sophisticated limit on availability that permits withdrawals but bounds the risk.
When the partition ends, there must be some way to both restore consistency and compensate for mistakes made while the system was partitioned. Restoring state is easy because the operations are commutative, but compensation can take several forms. A final balance below zero violates the invariant. In the normal case, the ATM dispensed the money, which caused the mistake to become external. The bank compensates by charging a fee and expecting repayment. Given that the risk is bounded, the problem is not severe. However, suppose that the balance was below zero at some point during the partition (unknown to the ATM), but that a later deposit brought it back up. In this case, the bank might still charge an overdraft fee retroactively, or it might ignore the violation, since the customer has already made the necessary payment.
In general, because of communication delays, the banking system depends not on consistency for correctness, but rather on auditing and compensation. Another example of this is “check kiting,” in which a customer withdraws money from multiple branches before they can communicate and then flees. The overdraft will be caught later, perhaps leading to compensation in the form of legal action.

title: 短链系统设计：从方法论到落地
content:
「设计一个短链系统」是系统设计题的常青树——它看着简单（不就是个映射吗），但面试官真正在考的是三件事：长 URL 怎么变成 7 位短码（发号与进制转换）、短码怎么存（分表 + 缓存分层）、跳转用 301 还是 302（状态码背后的业务意图）。 秒杀篇讲的是「写」场景（削峰、防超卖），短链篇讲的是「读」场景（缓存、布隆、热点）——两篇合起来，方法论的两个极端就都有了。读完你能在面试现场把这道题从头推到尾，并且说清每个选择的理由。

联动：本文是 系统设计方法论（需求澄清/容量估算/评估权衡）的第二个完整案例；与 秒杀系统设计（写场景）对照形成读写双案例；缓存分层与布隆过滤器复用 Redis 深度解析；发号器与分表复用 MySQL 高可用与分库分表实战、分布式系统核心理论（分布式 ID）。

1. 定位：这道题考什么短链系统的需求一句话：输入任意长 URL，输出 7 位短码；访问短链时重定向到原长 URL（如 t.cn/Ab3dE9 → 长链接）。
它为什么高频：短链表面是「字符串映射」，实际覆盖了系统设计的读路径全部考点——容量估算、哈希与冲突、发号器、分库分表、缓存分层、布隆过滤器、热点防护、301/302 语义。一题考完「读场景」所有基本功，这是它和秒杀（写场景）互补的原因。
与秒杀的核心对照（面试立论用）：



维度
秒杀（上一案例）
短链



场景类型
写密集（下单）
读密集（跳转）


核心矛盾
瞬时流量洪峰
热点 key 与缓存击穿


关键中间件
Redis 预扣 + MQ 削峰
Redis 缓存 + 布隆过滤器


容量估算重点
峰值 QPS（10 万级）
总量与读放大（百万级）


2. 需求澄清与容量估算（方法论第一步）面试先做需求澄清，别急着画架构——短链的四个关键问题：



问题
默认假设（可主动询问）
影响



每天新增多少长链接？
1000 万条/天
决定发号器吞吐与表容量


短链跳转 QPS？
峰值 2 万 QPS
决定缓存层级与热点策略


短码长度？
7 位（字母+数字 62 进制）
决定容量上限


数据保存多久？
长期（10 年）
决定总量与淘汰策略


容量估算（写出数字，面试加分）：
日新增 1000 万 → 年新增 36.5 亿 → 10 年 365 亿条7 位 62 进制容量：62^7 ≈ 3.5 万亿 ≫ 365 亿    ✅ 容量充足跳转峰值 2 万 QPS，读:写 ≈ 20:1（短链被反复访问）   → 读是主要矛盾单条记录 ~200B → 365 亿条 ≈ 7.3TB（10 年）   → 必须分表（≥64 张）

因果链：容量估算的结论直接决定架构——「总量 365 亿 → 单表扛不住 → 分 64 表；读 2 万 QPS → DB 扛不住 → 缓存扛 90%」——每一步架构决策都是上一步数字的推论，这是方法论的核心（完整流程见 系统设计方法论）。
3. 核心机制一：短码生成——发号器 + 62 进制3.1 为什么不用 MD5 截断


方案
问题



MD5 长 URL 截 7 位
哈希冲突概率随数据量上升，冲突要重算（循环）


随机短码
碰撞检测麻烦，每次生成要查重


发号器 + 62 进制
无冲突（号唯一）、可预测、可支持批量


短码 = 发号器拿到的自增 ID，转成 62 进制：ID=1 → "1"，ID=1000000 → "4c92"……7 位最多 62^7≈3.5 万亿个短码，用不完。
3.2 发号器三方案（面试核心）


方案
机制
优缺点



Redis INCR
单 key 自增
简单；Redis 挂影响发号，可持久化兜底


DB 号段（segment）
每次取一批号（如 1 万），内存发完再取
无网络往返、DB 压力小，生产主流


雪花算法
时间戳+机器号+序列号
无序、不可预测；但短码要「短」反而用它少见


因果链：发号器选型的关键是「发号频率 = 写入频率 = 日增 1000 万」——每次取号都打 Redis/DB 会打死存储，号段模式把「1 万次取号」合并成「1 次 DB 查询」（与 MQ 批量消费同一个思想：批量换吞吐）。面试答发号器：「DB 号段 + 内存发号」是标准答案，补一句『发号是写路径唯一瓶颈，所以必须批量』就是完整逻辑。
3.3 动手验证：号段发号的最小实现// 核心：批量取号，内存发放（伪代码）public class IdSegmentAllocator {    private long current;    // 内存当前号    private long max;        // 本批上限    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;    public long nextId() {        synchronized (this) {            if (current >= max) {           // 本批耗尽 → 取新号段                jdbc.update("UPDATE id_segment SET max_id = max_id + 10000 WHERE biz = 'short_url'");                current = jdbc.queryForObject(                    "SELECT max_id FROM id_segment WHERE biz = 'short_url'", Long.class);                max = current + 10000;            }            return current++;        }    }}

观察点：前 1 万次调用只触发 1 次 DB 更新（UPDATE ... + 10000），之后全部内存返回。判定标准：能说出「DB 压力 = 日增 1000 万 ÷ 号段 1 万 = 每天 1000 次写」——发号从「每秒 115 次」降到「每天 1000 次」，这就是号段的威力。
4. 核心机制二：存储与读取——分表 + 缓存分层4.1 存储设计


层
方案
理由



主表
MySQL，按短码 hash 分 64 表（short_url_0 ~ short_url_63）
10 年 365 亿条，单表 ~5.7 亿超阈值


路由
hash(short_code) % 64（或按 ID 段路由）
短码定表，读路径直查


冗余
主从 + 读写分离
读多写少，从库扛查询


索引
短码唯一索引
跳转按短码精确查


为什么分 64 表而不是 4 表：10 年数据量 × 单表 5.7 亿超红线（MySQL 单表 5000 万经验线）——分表数 = 总量 ÷ 单表容量，先把十年算完再定（细节见 MySQL 高可用与分库分表实战）。
4.2 缓存分层与布隆过滤器flowchart LR
    C["客户端"] -->|短链访问 2W QPS| NG["网关/本地缓存(Caffeine, 毫秒级)"]
    NG -->|未命中| R["Redis 缓存(命中率 ~95%)"]
    R -->|未命中| BF{布隆过滤器短码存在?}
    BF -->|不存在| E["直接返回 404(拦掉无效短码)"]
    BF -->|可能存在| DB[("MySQL 分表")]
    DB -->|回填| R
    R -->|回填| NG

因果链（这一层是全题精华）：缓存未命中的请求会打到 DB——但无效短码（用户乱拼的）每次都不存在，会绕开缓存直接打 DB（缓存穿透），2 万 QPS 里若有 10% 无效请求，DB 每秒要扛 2000 次无效查询 → 布隆过滤器在 DB 前拦一层：不存在直接 404，存在才放行。布隆的代价是「可能误判存在」但不误判不存在——宁放行一次空查，不放过一次真查（布隆过滤器原理与实现见 Redis 深度解析）。
4.3 动手验证：布隆拦截无效短码# Redis 布隆（RedisBloom 模块）docker run -d -p 6379:6379 redislabs/rebloom:2.6.0redis-cli BF.RESERVE short_url_filter 0.01 1000000000   # 误判率 1%，容量 10 亿redis-cli BF.ADD short_url_filter "Ab3dE9"              # 写入短码时同步加redis-cli BF.EXISTS short_url_filter "Ab3dE9"           # → 1（存在）redis-cli BF.EXISTS short_url_filter "Xx9Fz1"           # → 0（不存在，直接 404）

观察点：无效短码在布隆层即被拦，DB 零压力；写入短链时 BF.ADD 与 DB 同步（失败可容忍——误判只是多查一次）。判定标准：能说出布隆过滤器的取舍——「不存在的必拦，存在的可能漏拦（误判），所以它只防穿透、不防击穿」。
5. 核心机制三：301 vs 302 与热点防护5.1 301 还是 302（面试高频追问）


状态码
语义
对短链的影响



301
永久重定向
浏览器/客户端缓存跳转结果，下次直接访问长链——后续请求不经过我们，但无法统计点击量、无法修改跳转目标


302
临时重定向
每次访问都先打我们的服务——可以统计、可以改目标，但服务压力大


面试标准答案：选 302——短链是营销/内容运营工具，点击统计和可修改性是产品刚需，牺牲一点服务压力换这两个能力。因果链：301 把控制权交给了客户端缓存，302 把每次访问留在自己手里——「要数据就要 302」。
5.2 热点短链防护短链符合「二八定律」：20% 的短链扛 80% 的点击（爆款链接）。防护层次：



层
手段



本地缓存
Caffeine 短 TTL（秒级），挡住大部分热点


Redis
热点 key 天然被缓存吸收；单 key 打爆加本地缓存兜底


热点识别
计数器识别 topN 热点 → 加大本地缓存 TTL


限流
网关限流保护后端（见 秒杀篇 的限流章节）


因果链：读场景的雪崩风险是「热点 key 过期瞬间，大量请求同时打到 DB」——本地缓存（Caffeine）是第一层盾：Redis 挂了热点还在本地挡着。面试答「读场景高可用」的标准句式：「多级缓存 + 热点识别 + 网关限流」。
6. 完整架构图（读路径全景）flowchart LR
    U["用户"] -->|"t.cn/Ab3dE9"| LB["负载均衡"]
    LB --> W["短链服务集群"]
    W --> C1["Caffeine 本地缓存"]
    W --> R["Redis（短码→长链）"]
    W --> BF["布隆过滤器"]
    W --> DB[("MySQL 64 表")]
    R -->|回填| C1
    DB -->|回填| R
    DB --> ID["发号器(DB 号段)"]
    ID -->|"长链写入时取号"| DB
    W -->|302| U
    U --> L["长 URL 目标站"]

完整链路：写入（长链 → 发号取号 → 62 进制转短码 → 落 64 表 → 布隆 ADD → 缓存回填）；读取（短码 → 本地缓存 → Redis → 布隆 → DB → 逐级回填 → 302 跳转）。
7. 面试应答：短链六连问7.1 完整话术


面试题
回答要点



短码怎么生成？
发号器（DB 号段）取自增 ID → 62 进制转 7 位短码，无冲突


为什么不用 MD5？
截断有冲突率，冲突处理复杂；发号器确定性无冲突


数据怎么存？
按总量算分表（10 年 365 亿 → 64 表），短码唯一索引，主从读写分离


缓存穿透怎么防？
布隆过滤器拦无效短码：不存在必拦，存在可能误判放行


301 还是 302？
302：要点击统计与可修改性，每次访问留在自己手里


热点怎么防？
多级缓存（Caffeine + Redis）+ 热点识别 + 网关限流


发号器挂了怎么办？
号段模式 DB 压力极小；DB 用主从，主挂从顶上（号段不丢）


7.2 深挖：与秒杀的双案例对照（跨篇联动）


维度
秒杀（写场景）
短链（读场景）



核心矛盾
瞬时洪峰（写放大）
热点 + 穿透（读放大）


第一防线
限流（令牌桶/双层）
多级缓存（Caffeine→Redis）


中间件
MQ 削峰 + Redis 预扣
布隆过滤器 + Redis


容量重点
峰值 QPS 与库存原子性
总量 × 生命周期与命中率


最终兜底
对账 + 降级
302 语义 + 限流


一句话：秒杀教你怎么扛「一分钟的十万并发」，短链教你怎么扛「十年的每天两万」——一个是打（洪峰），一个是磨（长尾）。面试把两篇的对照讲出来，等于证明「方法论不是背的，是用的」。
8. 总结8.1 面试速答表


面试题
一句话答案



短码生成方案？
发号器（DB 号段）→ 62 进制，无冲突、可批量


号段发号原理？
一次取 1 万号内存发放，DB 压力从每秒降到每天


为什么 64 张表？
10 年 365 亿条 ÷ 单表 5.7 亿超线，分表数由总量反推


缓存穿透怎么防？
布隆过滤器：不存在的必拦，存在的可能放行


301 vs 302？
302：要统计与可改目标；301 把控制权交给客户端


热点怎么护？
本地缓存 + 热点识别 + 限流，Redis 挂热点仍挡得住


缓存击穿怎么防？
热点 key 永不过期 + 重建互斥锁（Redis 深度解析的经典方案）


8.2 实战避坑表


症状
原因
处理



短码偶尔跳错
62 进制实现有歧义字符
去掉 0/O、1/l/I 等易混字符


无效短码打爆 DB
缓存穿透
布隆过滤器（先写后读，注意写入同步）


热点链接雪崩
热点 key 过期同时回源
本地缓存 + 互斥重建 + 热点识别


发号器并发重复
号段分配无锁
内存分配 synchronized/乐观锁，DB 唯一索引兜底


改短链跳转目标
301 被客户端缓存
业务上不给改（301）或用 302 保修改能力


短码被遍历
顺序号可预测
号段偏移加盐（如 ID×随机步长）或哈希混淆


8.3 工具速查表


工具
用途



RedisBloom（BF.* 命令）
布隆过滤器落地


Caffeine / Guava Cache
本地缓存第一层


MySQL 分表（sharding-key 路由）
64 表路由


Nginx/Gateway 限流
网关层保护


链路监控（Prometheus+grafana）
命中率/回源率监控


8.4 本篇定位短链篇是系统设计「读场景」案例，与秒杀篇（写场景）形成完整闭环；「高性能/高可用/熔断限流降级」三个子导航页的具体机制（缓存分层、冗余、限流算法）在秒杀与短链两篇中均已落地，导航页将补充「内容已并入案例正文」的跳转说明。

title: 认知与分析能力指南
content:
一套只为提升认知与分析能力设计的阅读与训练系统。全部书目按一条准绳过滤——这本书是否直接提升我的认知或分析能力？对目标贡献微乎其微的书，一律排除。
定位：长期伴行轨道。与博客工作线（Java 后端面试导航 + 项目实战导航，硬期限 2027-05）并存：工作线冲突时，本系统无条件让路——认知提升不设硬期限，跨度可延长（见《决战 2027.05》取舍 4）。
标准节奏：每天45分钟 × 每周5天 × 6个月走完主线（6本书 × 3个模块），之后按兴趣进入进阶书单。伴行节奏：每天30-45分钟 × 每周3-5天；2027-05 前只要求”跑起来 + 完成 M1（认知地基）”，M2/M3 顺延投递后加码。每个模块结束过一次检查点（时间可顺延，验收标准不变）。


一、系统是什么三个模块按”能力”组织，而不是按学科或品味：
M1 认知地基（第1-6周）     系统之美 → 思考，快与慢M2 量化与博弈（第7-12周）  概率论基础教程 Ch.1-3 → 策略思维M3 实战收网（第13-24周）   资治通鉴精选8篇 → 毛泽东选集5篇检查点 CP1-CP3 逐模块把关


M1 认知地基：装两件最通用的元工具——看结构（系统）与看自己（认知偏差）
M2 量化与博弈：装两件进阶工具——算不确定性（概率/贝叶斯）与算互动（博弈论）
M3 实战收网：在千年真实案例上练手（通鉴），再用方法论收口（毛选）

四条铁律：

主线优先——只完成主线6本，系统就成立；进阶书单是加分项，读不读随你。
顺序固定——先装元工具，再装进阶工具，最后实战。上一模块检查点不过关，不进下一模块。
允许延期，不允许跳过——这是系统唯一的纪律。时间弹性是本系统的正式设计：伴行节奏下，24 周主线可拉长至 40+ 周，跨度延长不算违约。
工作线优先——与工作线（Java 面试 + 项目实战，2027-05 截止）冲突时让路，不因暂停而内疚；2027-05 前达标线 = M1 完成 + 系统在跑。

A1 第一性原理
剥离惯例与类比，拆到最底层假设，再从中重建
写下结论→连问5次”为什么”→找出最底层假设→检验今天是否仍成立→从假设重建
同行说”只能按惯例定价”→拆到底层=成本×支付意愿→边际成本≈0时定价逻辑完全不同

A2 二阶思维
每个行动问两遍”然后呢”，看清后果的后果
决策前写下：这么做之后会怎样？再之后呢？至少推两层
裁员→士气崩→人才流失→客户流失→成本更高

B1 贝叶斯更新
判断=先验信念+证据修正；P(H|E)=P(E|H)·P(H)/P(E)
写当前把握→新证据时问”假设为真时这证据多常见？为假时呢？”→按比例修正
发病率1%、假阳性5%，阳性结果→真实患病≈17%，不是95%

B2 期望值决策
决策=Σ(概率×损益)，选期望最大且最坏结果承受得起的
赌一把的决定写成表格（结果×概率×损益），EV最大且最坏可承受才做
跳槽offer（70%加薪/30%裸辞）vs 留任——算完再做情绪决定

B3 回归均值
极端表现之后必然回归平均；别把运气当实力或当衰
看到”连续超常/连续低迷”，先问：回归均值还是真实趋势？
上月销冠本月回落≠能力下降；股票连涨后回调≠崩盘
—


B4 幸存者偏差
你只看得见活下来的，结论天然被扭曲
看任何成功案例，主动找”同样做法的失败者名单”
成功学只讲上市的；”创业=九死一生”才是全集
—


B5 小样本噪声
样本小了，差异多半是噪声
涉及比率/排名/效果先看样本量（经验线：30个以上再认真）
新店开张两周的营业额、一次考试的排名——都是噪声

B6 相关≠因果
两件事同步变，可能是第三变量或反向因果
依次排除：反向因果？共同原因？巧合？
冰淇淋销量与溺水率正相关——共同原因=夏天

B7 边际思维+沉没成本
只看”多做一点”的增量；已花的钱和时间不参与决策
任何”继续还是放弃”，问”如果从头开始，我还会选它吗？”

D1 批判三问
任何权威话语，先问：谁在说？他为什么说？证据是什么？
贴在桌面；听到”专家说/大家都说/你应该”，过一遍三问再决定信不信

优先级



《物理学的进化》
第一性原理思维的沉浸训练（A1的完整版）
★★★


《学会提问》
系统化的批判性思维训练——评估主张、证据与推理
★★★


《模型思维》（Scott Page）
上百个模型的工具箱，直接扩展分析武器库
★★


《自私的基因》
用演化视角重新解释人类动机——分析行为的最深层原因
★★


《史记》选读（项羽本纪/高祖本纪/李将军列传/刺客列传/货殖列传）
更多决策案例，比通鉴更重人物性格与命运
★★


《鲁迅》3集（呐喊/野草/杂文名篇）
批判精神的完整养成（D1的完整版）
★★


《线性代数导论》（Strang，Ch.1-4）
多维视角——把问题当向量拆解
★


《普林斯顿微积分读本》
变化率与动态思维直觉
★


《毛选》续（《论持久战》等）
主要矛盾与战略分析方法的更多案例
★



七、实战：五步拆解法遇到任何人生难题，按此流程走一遍（30-60分钟，用笔记写下每一步）：

描述问题：一句话写完，删掉所有情绪词（”我完了”→”今年晋升名额3个，我排名第7”）。
工具映射：这问题该用哪套工具？（职业=概率+系统+博弈+历史；关系=认知偏差+框架；行动=主要矛盾+调查研究。）
逐个调用：从”我的工具箱”选最贴的工具，各写一两行分析。
整合判断：哪个工具揭示了主要矛盾？（多数问题死在把次要矛盾当主要矛盾。）
最小行动：本周只做一件小事，写下它和执行日期。

示范：商鞅变法《资治通鉴》周纪二记载：商鞅入秦行变法——连坐、军功爵、废井田、设县制。秦孝公支持二十一年，前338年孝公死，商鞅被车裂——但新法未废。这个案例值得用整套工具拆一遍：



工具
分析



矛盾分析
抓主要矛盾：对手不是”旧贵族”人群，而是”旧制度”结构。商鞅用军功爵重构激励机制，使旧贵族从阻力变成被瓦解的对象。


系统论
变法成功=改变了系统结构（军功爵=重新设计反馈回路），而非只换人；太子犯法、刑其师傅=修复执行反馈被扭曲的问题。


认知偏差
孝公的坚持反衬反对派”法古无过，循礼无邪”的说辞——锚定于过去。


博弈论
商鞅完成了”可信承诺”：徙木立信+王子犯法与庶民同罪（不可豁免的惩罚）——承诺机制到位，改革才推得动。


演化视角
旧贵族的抵抗是亲缘/阶层利益的演化本能；军功爵的成功在于把个体生存优势导向国家竞争力——个体利益与系统目标对齐。


批判视角
围观者的看客心态：改革最悲哀的不是敌人的枪，而是围观者的冷。


概率思维
变法的成败并非”改革必死”——同期各国变法，成败参半；商鞅的失败是特定博弈结构的结果，不是”变法”的宿命。


你会发现：单独读《资治通鉴》，你只得到一个”改革失败”的故事；用整套工具拆一遍，你得到一个可以反复套用的认知模型——任何组织变革、任何个人决策，都可以这样拆。
练习（CP3验收任务）： 用同样的结构拆”王安石变法”（史料出处：《宋史》《续资治通鉴长编》），重点回答：两次变法一成一败，差异分别验证了哪几个工具？

八、工具模板概念卡标题：________（如"反馈回路｜增强回路"）所属：M1/M2/M3/原理库A-D（如 M1·系统）来源：《系统之美》Ch.2 / 原理卡A2一句话定义：A↑→B↑→A↑，越滚越大现实案例：熬夜→状态差→效率低→更焦虑→更熬夜我的调用：____（当天或近期发生的一件事）下次复习：□1天 □3天 □7天 □30天

月度复盘
这个月读完了什么？
哪个概念最震撼我？
我实际调用了哪个工具？
下月目标是什么？

我的工具箱工具名 | 来源 | 我在____时用过它 | 效果

九、启动清单
今晚：买/借《系统之美》，完成读前仪式（荧光笔标出必读章节）；把”批判三问”和卡片模板抄到笔记第一页。
本周末（2小时）：通读第五章全部17张原理卡；确认CP1的验收标准。
明天起：读《系统之美》序言+第1章，写第1张卡片，睡前补一句”今天读到的概念解释了____”。连续14天，打卡不断。


这个系统不要求你自律，只要求你开始。CP1的任务就是”连续14天开始”——一旦跑起来，惯性会替你做剩下的事。伴行提醒：与工作线（2027-05）冲突时随时暂停、随时恢复——跨度可延长，系统永不废弃。

title: 系统设计方法论
content:
系统设计面试：从问题拆解到方案落地系统设计面试考的不是”你背过多少系统”，而是三件事：能不能把模糊需求拆成可讨论的设计决策、能不能说出每个选型的代价、能不能在追问下深入一层。本文按面试的能力维度组织：先讲解题思路（第 1 节），再讲三条设计主线——高性能、高可用、限流熔断降级（第 2~5 节），然后用 8 道真题演示框架（第 6 节），最后是 DDD 精华（第 7 节）与真题附录。
1. 系统设计面试的思路：不是背答案，而是学会拆解问题系统设计面试和八股文面试最大的区别：没有标准答案。面试官想看的不是”你见过这道题”，而是面对一个没见过的系统时，你的思考路径和取舍能力。
1.1 解题五步法第一步：需求澄清（5 分钟）
不要拿到题目就画架构图。先确认：

功能需求：核心用例是什么？（如短链系统的核心是”长转短”和”重定向”，而不是”统计”）
非功能需求（用数字对齐期望）：
QPS：读多还是写多？峰值多少？
延迟：P99 要求多少？重定向链路 200ms 内是合理的，交易链路要求更高；
数据量：总量多少、每天新增多少、保留多久；
一致性：强一致还是最终一致？能否容忍短暂不一致；
可用性：几个 9？成本随 9 的数量指数上升（见第 3 节）。


明确边界：这个系统”不需要”做什么，同样加分。

第二步：容量估算（10 分钟）
面试不要求精确，但要会”数量级”估算，并给出依据：

峰值 QPS ≈ 日请求量 / 86400 × 峰值系数（通常 3~10）；
存储 = 单条数据大小 × 条数 × 副本数 × 保留时间，再考虑分库分表；
带宽 = QPS × 单响应大小。

记住几个参照数，能帮你快速判断方案是否可行：



参照
量级



单台 MySQL 实例写 QPS
~1k


单台 MySQL 读 QPS（加缓存后）
~1 万+


单台 Redis QPS
~10 万


单台无状态应用服务器 QPS
~1 万（视业务）


100 万 QPS
大厂级，需要多级缓存 + 分片 + 异步化


决策依据：当估算出的 QPS 超过单机能力一个数量级时，就必须引入缓存、异步、分片——容量估算决定了架构选型，这是面试官判断你有没有经验的分水岭。
第三步：接口设计（5 分钟）
给出核心 API 的签名和语义，2~3 个关键的即可：
POST /api/v1/shortlinks      # 创建短链 {url, alias?} → {shortUrl}GET  /api/v1/{shortCode}     # 重定向 → 302 + Location: 长链接

第四步：数据模型（5 分钟）
给出核心表结构（字段、主键、索引），并说明存储选型的理由（MySQL / Redis / 对象存储），分片键怎么选。
第五步：架构选型与深挖（15 分钟）
画高层架构图，讲清楚请求路径，然后针对面试官追问的模块（往往是瓶颈点：缓存、分片、幂等）深入一层。主动指出系统的瓶颈与优化方向，比被问到才说更好。
1.2 45 分钟的时间分配


阶段
时间
产出



需求澄清
5 min
功能 + 非功能清单（全部量化）


容量估算
10 min
QPS、存储、带宽估算


高层设计
10 min
架构图 + 请求路径


深入设计
15 min
缓存/分片/一致性等关键决策


总结
5 min
瓶颈、权衡、扩展方向


1.3 三条原则
先说结论，再讲理由：每个选型都要能说出”为什么不用另一个方案”。
大胆做假设：需求没给数字，就自己假设并明说（”假设 DAU 1000 万，峰值 QPS 约 5 万”），面试官要听的就是假设 + 推导过程。
承认 trade-off：没有完美的方案，说出代价（如”用缓存换了强一致，但业务可接受最终一致”）是加分项。

面试官想要的回答：不是”我设计过一个短链系统”，而是”拿到任何题目，我都能先澄清需求、估算容量，再带着权衡理由做架构选型”——把面试题当成一次真实设计，而不是背诵。
2. 高性能设计：全链路找瓶颈，而不是堆缓存高性能优化的本质：在有限的硬件成本下，让系统在单位时间内处理更多请求、并降低响应时间。原则是先定位瓶颈、再针对性优化、最后压测验证——从用户请求到数据落地的全链路分析，而不是盲目堆缓存。
2.1 各层优化概览：一条请求走过的每一层都有优化空间


层
手段
收益



客户端
CDN 就近分发、静态化（商品详情页）、压缩（gzip/br）、长连接、HTTP/2
把大部分流量挡在业务系统之外


网关
限流、缓存、参数校验、协议转换
保护后端，前置拦截


服务层
异步化、连接池、批量读写、合理的并发模型、无状态化
提升单机吞吐，便于水平扩展


存储层
索引、读写分离、分库分表、冷热分离、慢查询治理
降低延迟与负载，绝大多数系统的瓶颈所在


决策依据：优化顺序应该是 先缓存 → 再异步 → 再批量 → 再扩展 → 最后才是数据库与 JVM 调优，每一步都要有数据支撑，避免”优化了个寂寞”。
2.2 缓存：性价比最高的优化多级缓存架构：数据按访问频率分层，越靠上越快、越贵、越小：



级别
代表
延迟
容量
说明



L1 本地缓存
Caffeine/Guava
纳秒级
单机 MB~GB
无网络开销，但有数据一致性问题


L2 分布式缓存
Redis
毫秒级
TB 级
多实例共享，命中率更高


L3 数据库
MySQL
10ms 级
无限
最后兜底


读请求先查 L1，miss 查 L2，再 miss 查 DB 并逐级回填——这就是”多级缓存”。
缓存更新模式对比：



模式
做法
优缺点



Cache Aside
读 miss 查库回填；写：先更新 DB，再删除缓存
主流方案，实现简单；DB 与缓存间有短暂不一致窗口


Read Through
缓存组件（旁路代理）负责回填
对业务无感，依赖中间件支持


Write Through
写 DB 的同时同步写缓存
强一致，但写放大、吞吐受限


Write Behind
先写缓存，异步批量落库
吞吐最高，但断电可能丢数据


决策依据：绝大多数业务选 Cache Aside + 先更新 DB 再删缓存。为什么”先删缓存再更新 DB”不行？——并发下旧数据可能被读回填，脏数据持续更久。为什么先更 DB 再删缓存仍有问题？——更新 DB 成功、删缓存失败时缓存里就是旧值，因此生产上常用延迟双删（删缓存 → 更新 DB → 延迟几百 ms 再删一次）或 Canal 订阅 binlog 异步删缓存兜底。
缓存三大经典问题：

穿透：查询一个不存在的 key，缓存不命中直接打到 DB，恶意请求可打垮 DB。
方案：参数合法性校验；缓存空值（短 TTL，如 5 分钟）；布隆过滤器前置拦截（见第 6 节）。


击穿：某个热点 key 恰好过期，瞬间大量并发打到 DB。
方案：互斥锁（重建缓存只允许一个请求回源，其余等待）；逻辑过期（key 永不过期，value 带过期时间，异步线程重建）；热点 key 永不过期 + 后台刷新。


雪崩：大量 key 在同一时间过期，DB 瞬间被压垮。
方案：过期时间加随机数（打散过期时间）；多级缓存兜底（L1 兜 L2）；加熔断限流保护 DB（见第 4、5 节）。



2.3 服务层与存储层的其他手段
异步化：发短信、写日志、积分、报表等非核心操作通过 MQ 削峰填谷，主链路只做”必要的事”——吞吐提升最立竿见影；
批量与连接复用：连接池（Druid/HikariCP）、HTTP Keep-Alive、批量读写（multiGet、batch insert）——减少网络往返（RTT）是提升性能最直接的手段；
索引优化：最左前缀、覆盖索引避免回表、避免函数与隐式类型转换导致索引失效；EXPLAIN 看 type/rows/Extra；
读写分离：主写从读，注意主从延迟——一致性敏感场景强制走主库；
分库分表：单表千万级以上按业务垂直拆分、按分片键水平拆分；同时要解决分布式 ID、跨分片分页聚合问题；
网络与运行时：零拷贝（Kafka/Netty 的 sendfile）、protobuf 优于 JSON、线程池参数（CPU 密集 ≈ 核数 + 1，IO 密集 ≈ 核数 × 2）、避免频繁 Full GC；
可观测与压测：APM（SkyWalking / Prometheus + Grafana）定位耗时分布，JMeter 压测找到系统水位线，再针对热点路径优化。

面试官想要的回答：把”高性能”拆成”缓存、异步、批量、扩展”四条主线，每条能讲清原理、适用场景和代价；遇到缓存必答三大问题（穿透/击穿/雪崩）与更新模式的选择依据——而不是背出一堆名词。
3. 高可用设计：用冗余换可靠性高可用的核心思想只有一句话：用冗余换可靠性——任何单点都可能故障，那就让每个组件都有多个副本，并通过故障转移让系统在部分组件故障时依然对外提供服务。
3.1 冗余设计
数据多副本：MySQL 主从/双主、Redis 主从 + Sentinel/Cluster、Kafka 多副本（副本因子默认 3），保证单节点故障不丢数据；
多可用区（Multi-AZ）：同一地域内不同可用区间网络延迟低（毫秒级）但故障域隔离（机房断电、光缆中断不会同时影响两个 AZ）。数据库跨 AZ 部署可将可用性从 99.9% 提升到 99.99% 量级；
多地域（Multi-Region）：异地多活（单元化部署），多个 Region 同时提供服务，故障时由 DNS/全局负载均衡把流量切到健康地域——最高级别的高可用，代价是数据双向同步与冲突解决的架构复杂度极高。

决策依据：从单机到多 AZ 到多 Region，可用性每升一个台阶，成本与复杂度都上一个数量级。先问”业务值不值得”，再谈架构。
3.2 故障转移


模式
做法
适用
代价



主备（Active-Passive）
备机不对外服务，主故障后由监控/仲裁切换：VIP 漂移（Keepalived）、DNS 切换、注册中心/etcd 选主
有状态的数据节点（MySQL、Redis）
备机闲置、切换有秒级到分钟级延迟


双活（Active-Active）
多个副本同时服务，负载均衡 + 注册中心自动摘除故障节点，对用户无感知
无状态服务（API 层标准做法）
需要处理状态共享与数据一致


集群选举
通过 Raft/Paxos 一致性协议选主（etcd、ZooKeeper、Kafka 控制器、Redis Cluster）
强一致的数据组件
实现复杂，依赖多数派（5 节点容忍 2 个故障）


决策依据：无状态用双活 + 自动摘除，有状态用主备/选主——不要给无状态服务设计 VIP 主备，那是把简单问题做复杂。
3.3 健康检查与优雅上下线
注册中心（Nacos/Eureka）通过心跳续约感知实例存活；消费者本地缓存可用实例列表，调用失败时快速重试下一个实例；
网关/Nginx 对后端做主动探活（/actuator/health、HTTP 状态码判断），连续失败自动摘除，恢复后自动加回；
优雅上下线：服务下线前先通知注册中心、再摘流量（等待正在处理的请求完成），避免发布期间的 5xx。

3.4 服务治理：限流 / 熔断 / 降级 / 隔离高可用不只是”多副本”，还包括故障下的体验保障：

超时与重试：连接超时 < 读超时；重试要幂等、要限次数（配合指数退避）；
限流：保护系统不被突发流量打垮（见第 4 节）；
熔断：下游故障时快速失败，防止级联雪崩（见第 5 节）；
降级：非核心功能返回兜底，保证核心链路可用（见第 5 节）；
隔离：线程池隔离/信号量隔离（如 Hystrix 按服务划分线程池），把故障限制在局部。

3.5 可用性指标：N 个 9可用性 = 正常运行时间 / 总时间，”几个 9”是业界量化的方式：



可用性
全年不可用时间
参考评价



99%（2 个 9）
87.6 小时
允许定期维护，内部系统常见


99.9%（3 个 9）
8.76 小时
大多数互联网业务的最低要求

4. 限流：保护系统不被突发流量打垮核心思想：在单位时间内，只允许特定数量的请求通过，超过阈值的请求将被拒绝、排队等待或降级处理。限流有三个层次的目的：保护自己（不被打垮）、保护下游（不把慢服务打到雪崩）、保证公平（不让大客户饿死小客户）。
4.1 四种经典算法固定窗口public class FixedWindowLimiter {    private final int maxRequests;    private final long windowMillis;    private int count = 0;    private long windowStart;    public FixedWindowLimiter(int maxRequests, long windowMillis) {        this.maxRequests = maxRequests;        this.windowMillis = windowMillis;        this.windowStart = System.currentTimeMillis();    }    public synchronized boolean allow() {        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();        if (now - windowStart > windowMillis) {            count = 0; // 重置计数器            windowStart = now;        }        if (count < maxRequests) {            count++;            return true;        }        return false;    }}

问题（临界问题）：窗口切换的瞬间，上一个窗口的最后一批请求和下一个窗口的第一批请求可以同时通过，实际流量达到 2 倍阈值。比如限制 1 分钟内 100 次，59.9s 时来了 100 次，60.0s 时又能进 100 次，同一秒内 200 次穿过限流。
滑动窗口计数把窗口切成若干小格子（如 1 分钟切成 6 个 10 秒格），统计窗口内所有格子计数之和。实现简单、内存固定，精度取决于格子数，是网关限流的常见做法：
/** * 滑动窗口计数：把窗口切成 N 个格子，判定时统计窗口内所有格子的计数之和。 * 相比固定窗口：边界突发被抑制到接近精确值；相比滑动日志：内存固定为 O(N)。 */public class SlidingWindowCounterLimiter {    private final int maxRequests;      // 窗口内允许的最大请求数    private final long bucketMillis;    // 每格时长（ms）    private final int bucketCount;      // 格子数    private final long[] counts;        // 每个格子的计数    private final long[] startMillis;   // 每个格子的起始时间    private long windowTotal;           // 当前窗口内总计数    public SlidingWindowCounterLimiter(int maxRequests, long windowMillis, int bucketCount) {        this.maxRequests = maxRequests;        this.bucketCount = bucketCount;        this.bucketMillis = windowMillis / bucketCount;        this.counts = new long[bucketCount];        this.startMillis = new long[bucketCount];    }    public synchronized boolean allow() {        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();        long bucketId = now / bucketMillis;               // 当前格子编号        long windowStartId = bucketId - bucketCount + 1;  // 窗口内最早的格子编号        // 清理滑出窗口的格子，同步更新窗口总数        for (int i = 0; i < bucketCount; i++) {            if (startMillis[i] != 0 && startMillis[i] / bucketMillis < windowStartId) {                windowTotal -= counts[i];                counts[i] = 0;                startMillis[i] = 0;            }        }        // 定位当前格子（环形取模）        int idx = (int) (bucketId % bucketCount);        if (startMillis[idx] / bucketMillis != bucketId) {            windowTotal -= counts[idx];  // 该槽位旧格子的计数已滑出窗口，补扣            counts[idx] = 0;            startMillis[idx] = now;        }        if (windowTotal >= maxRequests) {            return false;        }        counts[idx]++;        windowTotal++;        return true;    }}

滑动日志算法public class SlidingLogLimiter {    private final int maxRequests;    private final long windowMillis;    private final Queue<Long> timestamps = new LinkedList<>();    public SlidingLogLimiter(int maxRequests, long windowMillis) {        this.maxRequests = maxRequests;        this.windowMillis = windowMillis;    }    public synchronized boolean allow() {        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();        // 移除窗口外的请求时间戳        while (!timestamps.isEmpty() && now - timestamps.peek() > windowMillis) {            timestamps.poll();        }        if (timestamps.size() < maxRequests) {            timestamps.add(now);            return true;        }        return false;    }}

取舍：精确记录每个请求的时间，判定最准确（无临界问题）；但每个请求都要存时间戳，内存 O(窗口内请求数)，高 QPS 下不可接受——适合低 QPS、对精度要求高的场景。
漏桶算法public class LeakyBucketLimiter {    private final long capacity;    private long water = 0;    private long lastLeakTime;    private final long leakRateMillis; // 漏出间隔（毫秒/请求）    public LeakyBucketLimiter(int capacity, long leakRateMillis) {        this.capacity = capacity;        this.leakRateMillis = leakRateMillis;        this.lastLeakTime = System.currentTimeMillis();    }    public synchronized boolean allow() {        leakWater();        if (water < capacity) {            water++;            return true;        }        return false;    }    private void leakWater() {        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();        long elapsed = now - lastLeakTime;        long leaks = elapsed / leakRateMillis;        if (leaks > 0) {            water = Math.max(0, water - leaks);            lastLeakTime = now;        }    }}

特点：不管请求来得多猛，出去的速率恒定为 1/leakRateMillis，完全平滑；代价是不能应对突发流量——即使桶空着，请求也只能匀速通过。适合保护下游（如慢的第三方接口、写入数据库的批处理）。
令牌桶算法public class TokenBucketLimiter {    private final long capacity;      // 桶容量 = 最大突发量    private double tokens;    private long lastRefillTime;    private final double refillRate;  // 令牌/毫秒    public TokenBucketLimiter(long capacity, double refillPerSecond) {        this.capacity = capacity;        this.refillRate = refillPerSecond / 1000.0;        this.tokens = capacity;                    // 初始装满，允许首波突发        this.lastRefillTime = System.currentTimeMillis();    }    public synchronized boolean allow() {        refillTokens();        if (tokens >= 1) {            tokens -= 1;            return true;        }        return false;    }    private void refillTokens() {        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();        double elapsed = now - lastRefillTime;        // 每次补充以容量为上限：多余的直接丢弃        tokens = Math.min(capacity, tokens + elapsed * refillRate);        lastRefillTime = now;    }}

特点：匀速补充令牌 + 容量上限，既保证平均速率，又允许短时突发（桶里攒下的令牌一次花光）——突发是业务喜欢的（秒杀瞬间、首屏加载），所以 Guava RateLimiter、Sentinel、Spring Cloud Gateway 都基于令牌桶。对”突发上限”敏感的场景，把 capacity 调小即可。
